data.title: Show HN: Compass CNC – Open-source handheld CNC router
data.author: camchaney
data.article_summary: 这篇文章介绍了一款开源手持CNC雕刻机——Compass CNC。该设备结合了CNC技术的精准性和手动工具的灵活性与低成本，适合不想制作夹具或手不稳的人使用。它能够在实时自动校正，消除用户误差，同时提供手工操作的满足感。其3D设计、固件和电子设备均为开源，用户可以在GitHub上获取所有必要的资料来制作和修改自己的设备，并可通过电子邮件订阅加入社区。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕一个CNC项目的多方面讨论，包括产品展示、功能反馈、市场定位以及技术合规等问题。

不同观点：
• [sgc] 认为项目看起来很有趣，但建议将演示视频放在登陆页面上，并提供完成项目的照片示例以供参考。同时，对没有包含3D部件的套件，建议提供3D文件下载链接。
• [recipe19] 提到商用版本Shaper Origin的存在，指出其优点（易于发现错误）和缺点（速度慢，加工表面差），认为该项目可能更适合手工项目。
• [tealpod] 表达了对项目的美学赞赏，并分享了自己在CNC创业失败的经历。建议在主页上保留一个视频，并优化网站加载速度。
• [fxtentacle] 关注控制板PCB设计是否符合FCC规则，询问EMI测试和认证的细节，希望获取相关服务或实验室推荐。
• [Ductapemaster] 对Shaper Origin的高成本和订阅费用表示不满，认为该项目提供了更多的乐趣和实用性。
• [CodeWriter23] 表示在浏览URL时未能找到视频，可能存在用户体验问题。
• [itsdesmond] 询问是否提供升级路径，表明对购买套件的兴趣。
• [spiritplumber] 将该项目与Maslow进行比较，暗示可能有相似性。
• [robomartin] 对项目的使用场景提出质疑，认为传统xyz龙门机床在速度和精度上更具优势，并指出该项目的适用范围可能有限。
• [pcdoodle] 建议在市场验证后提高价格，显示对项目商业潜力的信心。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点之一是该CNC项目与商用Shaper Origin以及传统xyz龙门机床的比较。部分用户认为速度和精度不如传统设备，但也有用户认为该项目提供了独特的DIY乐趣和经济性。
• 另一个值得注意的讨论点是技术合规性，特别是EMI测试和认证问题，这涉及到产品公开销售的法律要求。
• 用户对视频和图片展示的需求较高，认为这有助于判断产品的功能和效果。
• 部分用户表达了对产品升级路径和价格策略的关注，显示出对长期投资的兴趣。

data.title: Show HN: Phind.design – Image editor & design tool powered by 4o / custom models
data.author: rushingcreek
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Phind.design 及其他AI图像编辑工具的使用体验、功能建议及技术问题

不同观点：
• **baalimago** 认为 Phind.design 在执行复杂图像编辑任务（如从图片中提取特定元素并放大）时表现不佳，无法准确完成用户要求。他指出，这种操作在传统图像编辑软件（如Photoshop）中较为简单，但对AI工具来说似乎非常困难。他还提到工具的指引不足，导致用户可能不知道如何正确使用。

• **adi_hn07** 对 Phind.design 给予高度评价，认为其用户界面和用户体验设计直观，图像生成质量高，且具备精确编辑功能，整体表现优异，甚至建议在更多平台上发布。

• **qq99** 提到在使用过程中容易进入“死聊天”状态，即系统报错后无法重试或重新提交请求，且返回主页尝试重新开始时会出现聊天历史附加到新聊天中的情况，造成困扰。

• **smusamashah** 反馈在使用样例提示后，自己的创意提示用完两次机会后无法查看历史记录，建议增加历史按钮功能以方便用户查看过去的提示。

• **john-tells-all** 分享了一个实际应用场景，即通过AI图像生成工具展示产品尺寸对比，认为这种功能在实际生活中非常实用，且首次尝试效果良好。

• **davidfiala** 希望看到更多示例作品或目录页面，以帮助用户更清晰地了解工具的可能性，而不必单独打开每个链接查看示例。

• **captaindiego** 提到曾因Phind不可用超过一周而切换到其他工具，询问Phind是否已恢复正常使用。

补充讨论：
• **swyx** 认为 Phind.design 的某些功能与其核心业务关系不大，提出对业务方向的疑问。
• **wwdx** 和 **richard___** 分别提到希望增加复制到Figma的功能和文本编辑功能，强调了特定功能的重要性。
• **WillAdams** 引用了关于无法分享训练数据中具体图像或摄影师信息的回复，涉及数据隐私和透明度问题。

争议焦点：
• Phind.design 在复杂图像编辑任务中的表现是否令人满意，baalimago持负面评价，而adi_hn07则给予高度评价。
• 工具的用户指引和错误处理机制是否足够友好，qq99和smusamashah都指出了使用中的不便之处。

data.title: Vector Tiles are deployed on OpenStreetMap.org
data.author: ikawe
data.article_summary: OpenStreetMap基金会宣布在其服务器上部署了矢量瓦片，并在OSM网站上发布了新图层。该项目经过数月测试，重点提升可靠性和速度，现已全面投入使用。新图层视觉效果更清晰、加载更快，基于全新后端技术。矢量瓦片具有高度适应性，开发者可基于现有的Shortbread样式进行自定义。使用这些瓦片需遵循《矢量瓦片使用政策》，该政策可能随后续问题进行调整。未来将进一步发展Shortbread规范和样式，欢迎社区提供反馈和建议。相关信息可在指定代码库中查阅。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：OpenStreetMap（OSM）引入矢量瓦片技术及其相关问题

不同观点：
• ikawe：解释了矢量瓦片与光栅瓦片的区别，指出矢量瓦片的优势，如文件体积小、灵活性高、可自定义样式，并提到OSM采用矢量瓦片较晚的原因，包括工程能力不足和旧设备性能问题。
• stevage：提供了新矢量图层"Shortbread"的访问方式，并提供了比较链接，指出可以通过这些链接体验新图层。
• severak_cz：认为"Shortbread"默认样式丑陋，缺乏对比度和细节，但承认可以通过自定义样式解决。
• amluto：指出矢量图层中街道名称显示不稳定，在缩放时会出现名称闪烁的问题。
• maelito：关注生成矢量瓦片所需的时间和资源，并分享了正在进行的基准测试。
• dolmen：指出矢量瓦片缺少一些重要细节，如私人路径上的门和商店名称。
• butz：质疑矢量瓦片是否真的更快，建议进行相同细节层次的比较，并询问是否已有类似的矢量样式。
• perrygeo：回应关于"Shortbread"样式的抱怨，强调矢量瓦片的真正优势是客户端可自定义样式，无需重新生成图像，大大提高了效率。
• colkassad：询问为何不提供每日或每周的全球mbtiles，类似于AWS上提供的OSM pbfs。
• neomantra：提醒大家OSM矢量瓦片是赞助工作的成果，并鼓励捐赠支持OSM基金会。
• wiz21c：询问矢量瓦片在OSM中使用的内存比光栅瓦片更多还是更少。
• davidkwast：表示已经使用矢量瓦片，并欢迎其他来源的矢量瓦片。
• eulgro：表示不了解矢量瓦片，并提供了维基百科的解释链接。

补充讨论：
• 矢量瓦片的优势与灵活性是讨论的核心，但也存在样式和细节显示问题。
• 社区对新技术的接受度和具体实现仍有不同看法，尤其是样式和细节的呈现。
• 技术实现的资源消耗和性能比较也是关注点，特别是与光栅瓦片的对比。
• 社区对开放数据和赞助工作的支持和认可。

44653136.article_content:
We are happy to announce the
deployment of Vector Tiles
on OpenStreetMap Foundation servers and the publication of the layer on the
OSM website
! We have been working hard to bring you a fresh look to OSM data, paired with exciting technological upgrades.
Work has been progressing since last year. In
June 2024 we shared progress
, including the launch of the vector tiles demo site, as well as details on the technical background on the tools being used. Since then we have put the
tile generation process through months of testing
, focused on reliability and speed improvements, and gotten ready for full production use.
Now, with integration of the vector tiles as a feature layer on the
OpenStreetMap website
, mappers and visitors get
a visual layer that is sharper and quicker, based on an entirely new backend
.
A major benefit of vector tiles is adaptability, so developers can leverage this vector source to develop their own styles based on the existing
Shortbread styles
or write a new one and use the new OSMF-hosted tiles. To use OSMF vector tiles in a project, in a development or production environment, consult the
Vector Tile Usage Policy
. Note that the policy may be subject to change to address any issues that come up after this launch.
From this point, you can expect further evolution of the Shortbread spec and styles.
Input on the direction, ideas, and issues with OSMF vector tiles are welcome
. Share in the appropriate repository:
spirit
for styles,
tilekiln
for tile generation, and
shortbread-tiles
for the tile content specification.

data.title: AI groups spend to replace low-cost 'data labellers' with high-paid experts
data.author: eisa01
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：生物医学领域中数据标注的挑战、报酬问题、数据开放性以及对人工智能（AI）模型训练的影响。

不同观点：
• **panabee** 认为，生物医学领域的数据集常包含不准确的信息，因为缺乏准确性激励且合格的标注者稀缺。为了解决这一问题，其团队付费让斯坦福医学博士标注新问题，并计划将数据集开源。同时指出，医疗领域的动态性使得已训练的模型容易过时，如2024年美国预防服务工作组对乳腺癌筛查指南的修改。
• **vidarh** 分享了自己作为标注者的经验，指出虽然部分人可以获得高报酬，但大多数工作是由低成本标注者完成的。其提到工作流程复杂，常包括多阶段的审查，且工具的应用正试图减少专家所需的时间。
• **the_brin92** 提到自己从事该领域工作多年，见证了项目的复杂性和模型存在的问题。其人文背景帮助了对“更好”模型响应的主观判断。
• **TheAceOfHearts** 主张数据集应免费开放，否则会导致重复劳动和资源浪费，并质疑数据集作为企业护城河的思维会限制创新。

• **TrackerFF** 注意到数据标注相关的咨询需求增加，但认为创办数据标注公司并非进入AI领域的最佳方式。
• **scotty79** 主张训练数据应开放，并建议废除版权以促进进步，认为版权不应阻碍现代进步的引擎。
• **rnxrx** 预测私营企业将通过标记和出售无用数据集来获利，这可能对传统业务的估值产生重大影响。
• **SoftTalker** 提到“苦涩的教训”（指依赖大数据和计算能力而非人类设计的特征），质疑当前做法的有效性。
• **some_random** 指出低质量标注是行业中的大问题，且许多偏见直接源于此。
• **cryptokush** 和 **verisimi** 以幽默方式提到数据标注工作的繁琐和自动生成数据的可能性。

• 数据标注在生物医学领域的重要性及挑战，尤其是准确性和动态性问题。
• 数据标注工作报酬的不均衡，部分高技能工作者获得高报酬，但整体工作多由低成本工作者完成。
• 数据集开放性及版权问题，讨论了开放数据集对创新的潜在影响。
• 数据标注工作的复杂性和工具应用的趋势，以及对AI模型训练的影响。
• 对当前数据标注和AI发展模式的批评与反思，包括对“苦涩的教训”的提及。

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：用户对早期网页设计、尤其是90年代风格的怀旧与讨论，包括简单UI、GIF图片、个人网站以及相关软件和资源。

不同观点：
• [怀旧与简单UI] tsumnia 表达了对现代网页设计复杂性的不满，怀念90年代简单的网页设计，尤其是GIF图片和简约的用户界面。
• [个人经历] standardUser 回忆了自己在1994年左右创建个人网站的经历，强调了当时网站的个性化，尤其是图标和计数器的使用。
• [技术工具回忆] miffe 询问是否有人记得一款叫 "Terralogic Texture Maker" 的软件，用于生成特定图像，显示出对过去工具的怀念。
• [编程启蒙] jaynate 提到Geocities和Angelfire是自己网页编程的启蒙，认为虽然现代网页技术更加复杂，但基础仍然相同。
• [资源识别] simoneau 和 chromehearts 试图识别出一些旧资源和背景图片的来源，提到90年代的资源包和项目。
• [技术难题] gopher2000 希望找回自己过去的GeoCities页面，但由于忘记具体URL和编号而遇到困难，提出了通过互联网档案馆查找的方法。
• [对页面设计的评价] luckystarr 以幽默的方式指出页面没有使用框架，因此不算非常旧，暗示了90年代网页技术的演变。
• [资源需求] SpecialistK 询问是否有人将旧网页元素打包成可下载的档案，显示出对怀旧资源的进一步需求。
• [美学欣赏] Gualdrapo 表达了对 tile 桌面壁纸背景的喜爱，对这种风格表示感谢。
• [技术问题] giancarlostoro 提到页面加载问题，怀疑是由于公司防火墙导致无法正常访问，间接提到现代企业技术环境对怀旧体验的影响。
• [幽默评论] luc_ 和 p3rls 以轻松幽默的方式参与讨论，p3rls 特别提到了过去使用cjb.net域名重定向的经历。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点：部分用户怀念过去网页设计的简单性，并对现代网页设计表示不满（如tsumnia），而其他用户如jaynate则认为虽然现代技术更复杂，但基础仍然相同。
• 讨论中的技术问题：gopher2000 提到找回旧网页的困难，特别是忘记URL和编号时如何利用互联网档案馆。
• 资源需求和分享：一些用户（如SpecialistK）希望能够找到打包的怀旧资源，而其他用户如PixelMoondust和chromehearts则分享了他们的资源和经历。

总的来说，讨论围绕着对90年代网页设计风格的怀旧，个人网站的回忆，以及相关工具和资源的识别与分享。

data.title: SQL Injection as a Feature
data.author: foxfired
data.article_summary: 这篇文章讲述了一个日志管理网站如何从一个简单的报告页面演变成一个允许用户直接编写SQL查询的系统。最初，页面只允许用户输入日期范围和关键词来生成报告。随着时间推移，由于不断有增加字段、生成新报告类型的需求，开发人员逐渐通过硬编码SQL和添加功能来满足这些要求。由于报告类型不断增多，用户开始抱怨名称混乱，开发人员转而使用数据库驱动报告名称，并允许编辑报告名。随着需求进一步复杂化，有人提出让用户自行编写SQL查询，最终这个功能被秘密添加到一个未公开的页面中，成为“SQL注入即服务”。尽管后来添加了一些简单的安全措施和查询限制，系统实际上已将整个数据库暴露给用户。这个演变过程展示了在长达十年的需求累积和小修小补下，一个系统如何逐渐变得脆弱和不安全。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：在应用程序中允许用户编辑和执行SQL查询的安全性与可行性

不同观点：
• **adontz** 认为在业务系统中，用户可能没有对某些表的原始数据权限，但可以有对包含汇总数据的报告的权限。他提到一种安全的SQL查询执行机制，包括检查查询是否为SELECT查询、限制超级用户编辑、参数化查询以及独立的权限系统，这种方法在实践中是可行且安全的。

• **EvanAnderson** 分享了一个关于自定义应用程序的负面经验，其中开发者使用字符串拼接构建查询，导致安全漏洞。用户通过滥用过滤字段可以执行未授权的查询操作，甚至总结出各种“魔法咒语”来获取数据。这强调了不当SQL执行的潜在风险。

• **theknarf** 建议直接创建只读数据库用户并删除不安全的工具，提供类似MySQL Workbench或phpMyAdmin的工具供用户使用，以减少安全隐患。

• **dml2135** 讲述了自己在工作中通过试验发现系统漏洞的经历，虽然通过技巧改进了工作流，但也意识到这种操作存在注入攻击的风险。

• **ivanjermakov** 批评了通过字符串搜索来限制SQL操作的方法，认为应该使用数据库自身的权限系统来限制连接权限。

• **lenkite** 提供了一种方法，给分析师一个SQLite快照副本，让他们可以使用自己喜欢的工具自由操作，从而在不影响主数据库的情况下进行分析。

• **zihotki** 提到使用SQL解析器和AST walker验证查询是否安全，只允许执行白名单中的SQL操作，这种方法有效地防止了SQL注入。

• **heckintime** 建议使用DBeaver或Bigquery等工具，限制用户访问特定视图以避免昂贵的查询，并提到Looker等工具可以帮助生成查询模型。

• **crazygringo** 强调在现代多用户数据库中限制用户只读权限和设置查询超时是相对容易且有效的安全措施。

• **somat** 分享了自己将数据库权限系统与应用权限系统结合使用的经验，虽然在小规模应用中效果不错，但不推荐在大规模或高风险环境中使用。

• **LikesPwsh** 建议给分析师直接SQL访问时，应推荐他们使用IDE而不是在文本框中构建自己的IDE。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点在于直接执行SQL查询的安全性和可控性，尤其是用户通过各种技巧或漏洞获取未授权数据的可能性。
• 讨论中也提到了不同的安全措施和工具，如SQL解析器、权限系统、只读数据库用户和外部工具（如MySQL Workbench、DBeaver、Looker等）的使用。
• 另一个值得注意的讨论点是使用AI工具辅助生成查询模型的潜在应用和前景。

44638304.article_content:
Looking at old applications, we always wonder who in their right mind thought of building them so badly. But every repository has its story and every effort has noble origins. I encountered such an application in my career, and I was lucky enough that they had used version control to preserve its history. Let me describe how the application looked in its latest state.
This was a website that managed logs for millions of devices around the world. In the report page, you could query the most prevalent type of error that occurred in the wild and track it through time to see when it was introduced and when it was resolved. A pretty useful report.
The problem was, in the UI, you didn't have a button or a link to get to the report. Instead, you were presented with a text box where you could write the SQL queries yourself. In other words, this was a SIAAS, most commonly known as SQL Injection As A Service. The entire database was exposed for anyone who had access to the service.
Traveling through time and CSV (version control), I discovered the initial commit when the report was first started more than a decade earlier. The page was a typical report page where you could enter a date range, some keywords, and click a "Generate" button. Through time, it transformed into its final form, a pure text field where you could type your raw SQL.
How did it happen? Well, with one request at a time over the span of 10 years.
1. Add just one more field
The first request was to add an additional field to the report. The developer added the field in the hard-coded SQL string inside the application, then updated the UI to read this new field. Easy enough. Everyone was happy.
But then there was a second request. This one was a bit harder. The requested field was in a different table. When the developer joined the new table, some of the results were incorrect or incomplete. Others complained that they were not seeing the data anymore. It took some restructuring to fix the report.
But then, someone complained that they didn't want that field in the report. It was messing with their VLOOKUP. After a long discussion, it was agreed that all new fields should be appended at the end of the table. Of course, this was weird since there were now some fields appearing after the creation date field.
2. New Features requested
But the developers didn't give up. They created a dropdown where you could select the type of report you wanted to generate. This was a neat feature. You could get the exact report you wanted without having to disrupt your own workflow. But with this feature came an invitation to create new report types. It might have started with 2 reports, but now there were dozens of them. Some were the same reports with fields slightly rearranged.
New complaints came in that the names of the reports didn't reflect what they were for. And the naming convention was confusing. So naturally, the developers switched from hardcoded names in the code to database-driven report names. You could now edit the report name... but what about creating your own report?
3. Everyone gets their own Report
This idea was rejected. Giving users the ability to create their own report was too hard. Instead, developers would discuss with analysts what they wanted to see in their report and write the appropriate query for it. Now, the dozen reports shot up to 2 dozen. 44638304.article_summary: 这篇文章讲述了一个日志管理网站如何从一个简单的报告页面演变成一个允许用户直接编写SQL查询的系统。最初，页面只允许用户输入日期范围和关键词来生成报告。随着时间推移，由于不断有增加字段、生成新报告类型的需求，开发人员逐渐通过硬编码SQL和添加功能来满足这些要求。由于报告类型不断增多，用户开始抱怨名称混乱，开发人员转而使用数据库驱动报告名称，并允许编辑报告名。随着需求进一步复杂化，有人提出让用户自行编写SQL查询，最终这个功能被秘密添加到一个未公开的页面中，成为“SQL注入即服务”。尽管后来添加了一些简单的安全措施和查询限制，系统实际上已将整个数据库暴露给用户。这个演变过程展示了在长达十年的需求累积和小修小补下，一个系统如何逐渐变得脆弱和不安全。
44638304.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：在应用程序中允许用户编辑和执行SQL查询的安全性与可行性

不同观点：
• **adontz** 认为在业务系统中，用户可能没有对某些表的原始数据权限，但可以有对包含汇总数据的报告的权限。他提到一种安全的SQL查询执行机制，包括检查查询是否为SELECT查询、限制超级用户编辑、参数化查询以及独立的权限系统，这种方法在实践中是可行且安全的。

• **EvanAnderson** 分享了一个关于自定义应用程序的负面经验，其中开发者使用字符串拼接构建查询，导致安全漏洞。用户通过滥用过滤字段可以执行未授权的查询操作，甚至总结出各种“魔法咒语”来获取数据。这强调了不当SQL执行的潜在风险。

• **theknarf** 建议直接创建只读数据库用户并删除不安全的工具，提供类似MySQL Workbench或phpMyAdmin的工具供用户使用，以减少安全隐患。

• **dml2135** 讲述了自己在工作中通过试验发现系统漏洞的经历，虽然通过技巧改进了工作流，但也意识到这种操作存在注入攻击的风险。

• **ivanjermakov** 批评了通过字符串搜索来限制SQL操作的方法，认为应该使用数据库自身的权限系统来限制连接权限。

• **lenkite** 提供了一种方法，给分析师一个SQLite快照副本，让他们可以使用自己喜欢的工具自由操作，从而在不影响主数据库的情况下进行分析。

• **zihotki** 提到使用SQL解析器和AST walker验证查询是否安全，只允许执行白名单中的SQL操作，这种方法有效地防止了SQL注入。

• **heckintime** 建议使用DBeaver或Bigquery等工具，限制用户访问特定视图以避免昂贵的查询，并提到Looker等工具可以帮助生成查询模型。

• **crazygringo** 强调在现代多用户数据库中限制用户只读权限和设置查询超时是相对容易且有效的安全措施。

• **somat** 分享了自己将数据库权限系统与应用权限系统结合使用的经验，虽然在小规模应用中效果不错，但不推荐在大规模或高风险环境中使用。

• **LikesPwsh** 建议给分析师直接SQL访问时，应推荐他们使用IDE而不是在文本框中构建自己的IDE。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点在于直接执行SQL查询的安全性和可控性，尤其是用户通过各种技巧或漏洞获取未授权数据的可能性。
• 讨论中也提到了不同的安全措施和工具，如SQL解析器、权限系统、只读数据库用户和外部工具（如MySQL Workbench、DBeaver、Looker等）的使用。
• 另一个值得注意的讨论点是使用AI工具辅助生成查询模型的潜在应用和前景。

Businesses, too, are risking their secrets. No logs
Other AI companies keep a record of all your conversations on their servers, leaving this information vulnerable to data leaks or exploitation for profit. Lumo doesn’t keep any logs of your conversations server side, and any chats you save can only be decrypted on your device.

Proton Mail
,
Proton Drive
, and
Proton Pass
. Our encryption is open source and trusted by over 100 million people to secure their data.
No data sharing
Big Tech companies share your data with third-party vendors, advertisers, and
government agencies for online surveillance
. Lumo’s no logs and encrypted architecture ensure we don’t have data to share, and our European home gives you the benefit of robust privacy protections, outside of US jurisdiction.

When this kind of training occurs, your personal data could end up being used to generate outputs for others’ conversations. Lumo won’t ever expose you to this risk, which is especially important for businesses working with confidential material.
Open
Lumo is based upon open-source language models and operates from Proton’s European datacenters. This gives you much greater transparency into the way Lumo works than any other major AI assistant. Unlike Apple Intelligence and others, Lumo is not a partnership with OpenAI or other American or Chinese AI companies, and your queries are never sent to any third parties. Our research and development will remain focused on open models, which we will continuously improve and augment.

data.title: Manticore Search: Fast, efficient, drop-in replacement for Elasticsearch
data.author: klaussilveira
data.article_summary: Manticore Search 是一个易于使用、开源且快速的数据库，专为搜索功能设计，是 Elasticsearch 的优秀替代品。其特点包括：速度极快，相比 MySQL 和 Elasticsearch 在不同数据集上的表现更为优越；采用现代多线程架构，能充分利用 CPU 核心，提供快速响应时间。支持行存储和列存储，适合处理大小不同的数据集。使用 PGM 索引实现高效的次级索引，并具备基于成本的查询优化器。Manticore 支持 SQL 语法和 MySQL 协议，兼容多种编程语言和 Elasticsearch 的写入功能。内置多主复制、负载均衡、实时插入和数据同步功能，且提供简单易用的备份和恢复工具。已被多家知名公司采用，并从 Sphinx 2.3.2 分叉而来。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Manticore Search与其他搜索工具（如Elasticsearch）的比较及其独特功能

不同观点：
• snikolaev（Manticore Search维护者）认为，Manticore Search经常被拿来与Elasticsearch比较，但它们并非直接替代品。Manticore专注于性能、简洁性以及避免供应商锁定，使用自己的SQL查询语言和REST端点。他提到其他类似工具如Typesense和Meilisearch，并询问用户对性能比较和扩展挑战的需求。
• mdaniel指出，"drop-in"这一表述不准确，因为Manticore有自己的查询语言和不同的端点输入格式，误导用户可能导致不良后果。
• sandstrom提到Typesense和Meilisearch也是Elasticsearch的替代品，且这些工具正在尝试替代Algolia的云服务。
• pQd分享了使用Manticore（前身是Sphinx）16年的经验，称其稳定且能够处理大量文档，尽管仍在使用旧模式。
• tonyhart7表示已经有一个Elasticsearch的替代品Meilisearch。
• wavemode对Manticore从Sphinx分支出来的原因及其今天的不同之处感到好奇。
• another_twist对Manticore的架构和20倍速度提升的来源感到好奇，并提到与其他引擎如Tantivy和Lucene的性能比较。
• cess11赞赏Manticore易于设置、资源占用少且速度快，特别提到其查询词自动加粗功能在原型设计和探索性浏览中非常便利。

补充讨论：
• Manticore Search的定位：虽然经常被与Elasticsearch比较，但Manticore维护者强调其独特性，特别是在性能、简洁性和避免供应商锁定方面的优势。
• 关于"drop-in"表述的争议：有用户认为Manticore使用自己的查询语言和端点，不应称为"drop-in"替代品，以免误导用户。
• 其他替代工具：讨论中提到了Typesense、Meilisearch等其他搜索工具，显示出这一领域的竞争和多样性。
• 性能和架构：有用户对Manticore的性能提升来源和架构细节表示关注，并希望看到更详细的性能比较和基准测试。
• 用户体验：有用户分享了长期使用Manticore的积极经验，特别是其在特定应用场景中的便利功能。

争议焦点：Manticore是否可以被称为Elasticsearch的"drop-in"替代品，以及如何准确传达其独特功能和定位。

With its modern multithreading architecture and efficient query parallelization capabilities, Manticore is able to fully utilize all your CPU cores to achieve the quickest response times possible.
The powerful and speedy full-text search works seamlessly with both small and large datasets.
Row-wise storage for small, medium and big size datasets.
For even larger datasets, Manticore offers columnar storage support through the
Manticore Columnar Library
, capable of handling datasets too big to fit in RAM.
Performant secondary indexes are automatically created using the PGM-index (Piecewise Geometric Model index), which provides efficient mapping between indexed keys and their memory locations.
The cost-based query optimizer uses statistical data about indexed data to evaluate and determine the most efficient execution plan.
Manticore is SQL-first, utilizing SQL as its native syntax, and offers compatibility with the MySQL protocol, allowing you to use your preferred MySQL client.
With clients available in

,
Python
,

JavaScript
,
Typescript
,
Java
,
Elixir
,
Go
, and
Rust
, integration with Manticore Search becomes easy.
Manticore also provides a programmatic HTTP JSON protocol for more versatile data and schema management, with Elasticsearch-compatible writes support.
Built in C++, Manticore Search starts quickly and uses minimal RAM (around 40MB RSS for an empty instance), with low-level optimizations contributing to its impressive performance.
With real-time inserts, newly added or updated documents are immediately accessible.
Interactive courses are available through
Interactive courses
to make learning a breeze.
Manticore also boasts built-in virtually synchronous multi-master replication using the Galera library and load balancing capabilities.
Data can be synced from sources such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, ODBC, xml, and csv with ease.
While not fully ACID-compliant, Manticore supports isolated transactions and binary logging for safe writes.
Effortless data backup and recovery with built-in tools like manticore-backup and SQL BACKUP command

• 性能和架构：有用户对Manticore的性能提升来源和架构细节表示关注，并希望看到更详细的性能比较和基准测试。
• 用户体验：有用户分享了长期使用Manticore的积极经验，特别是其在特定应用场景中的便利功能。

争议焦点：Manticore是否可以被称为Elasticsearch的"drop-in"替代品，以及如何准确传达其独特功能和定位。

data.title: Checking Out CPython 3.14's remote debugging protocol
data.author: ingve
data.article_summary: Python 3.14引入了一个新功能，允许通过`python -m pdb -p pid`将pdb调试会话连接到一个正在运行的Python进程。这使得开发者可以在无需提前修改代码或重启程序的情况下，动态调试运行中的进程。文章介绍了如何使用`sys.remote_exec`方法向指定进程ID的Python进程注入并执行代码。具体来说，开发者可以在一个Python REPL中调用`sys.remote_exec(pid, script_path)`，让目标进程执行指定的脚本。文章通过一个简单的累加整数的程序演示了该功能的实际应用，展示了如何在不中断程序运行的情况下，远程注入代码以查看调用栈信息。这一新功能降低了调试Python程序的门槛，简化了调试流程，并减少了对CPython内部细节的依赖。

From Python 3.14,
python -m pdb -p pid
lets you connect a
pdb
session to a running Python process.
This post goes into a part of what makes this possible.
The barrier to entry for writing general debugging tools for Python programs has always been quite low. Unlike many languages, you're rarely finding yourself working with weird internals. Instead, debugging tools can be built off of pretty straightforward knowledge of the language.
This is powered by the languages treating things like exception tracebacks as first class objects, standard library modules like
traceback
, and of course the power of
eval
/
exec
.
And thanks to this, tools like
pdb
can be provided out of the box, and easily customized by people without much (if any) understanding of the internals of the language.
Some might comment that the existence of things like
pdb
have prevented Python programmers from "simply" learning how to use more universal debuggers like
gdb
/
lldb
. But I believe that loads of excellent REPL-based debugging experimentation happens because People can simply write tools like
ipdb
or
pdb++
in Python.
There's always been a bit of a catch, though. Generally these debugging tools require you first to edit your program source.
You can easily stick a:

pdb

.
set_trace
()
right in the middle of your program near a problematic spot, or even set up an exception handler beforehand to capture outright exceptions.
But if you haven't done this work beforehand, you'll likely end up needing to edit your source code somehow, restart your program, and then go into it.
There are tools that can work without restarting the program. Beyond language agnostic debugging tools, tools like
pyspy
can work on running processes. But they are often relying on tricks and needing to know very specific details about CPython to work.

data.title: Neil Armstrong's customs form for moon rocks (2016)
data.author: ajuhasz
data.article_summary: 本文讲述了阿波罗11号宇航员在1969年从月球返回地球后，按照美国海关规定填写了一份入境申报表的趣闻。这份申报表通常由国际旅客填写，列出携带的植物、食物、动物、土壤等物品。而阿波罗11号的宇航员在飞行编号为“Apollo 11”、出发地为“月球”的申报表上，申报了他们从月球带回的“月岩和月尘样本”。健康声明部分关于“可能导致疾病传播的条件”一栏，填写为“待定”。该申报表由曾接送宇航员尼尔·阿姆斯特朗的飞行员、加州大学校友Luama Mays分享给杂志。阿姆斯特朗于2012年去世，享年82岁。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：阿波罗登月后的检疫程序是否为形式主义，以及其他历史或现代情境下的海关和检疫趣闻。

不同观点：
• perihelions和引用的文章认为，阿波罗登月后的生物危害检疫程序主要是表演性质的，实际上并没有严格的科学依据。文章指出，检疫更多是为了展示而非实际需要。
• smnrchrds分享了英国伞兵在纪念D-Day时被法国海关检查护照的趣闻，将历史事件与现代海关程序的滑稽性联系起来。
• ortusdux提到了阿波罗保险封的例子，说明了宇航员在没有生命保险覆盖情况下的创新应对措施，这与检疫程序的形式主义形成另一种对比。
• magicalhippo讲述了一个关于挪威海上石油平台出口报关时遇到的价值申报问题的故事，强调了实际操作中海关系统的局限性。
• jleyank幽默地指出，曾有宇航员因“不在国内”而需要申请税务延期，呼应了登月任务带来的行政管理挑战。
• ceejayoz和aspir提到阿波罗宇航员入关申报单的趣闻，认为这可能只是当时的一个玩笑，并提供了NASA发言人的确认。

补充讨论：
• yardie质疑阿波罗11号宇航员为何需要过海关，因为月球并不属于任何国家，这与常规国际旅行不同。
• hiccuphippo分享了一个关于奥兰多主教对月球拥有管辖权的宗教趣闻，增加了讨论的趣味性。
• the__alchemist提到卡塔尔的外国机组人员执行任务后需要进行申报的现代例子，展示了类似问题在今天的应用。
• rob74和nullbyte对美国海关申报表中特别提到蜗牛表示好奇，引发了对具体动植物检疫要求的讨论。

争议焦点：阿波罗登月后的检疫程序是否仅仅是形式主义表演，或者是否具有实际的科学价值。这涉及到历史事件的解读和不同来源信息的真实性。

44660437.article_content:
Anything to declare?
Trip to moon required Apollo 11 crew to sign U.S. Customs declaration to enter the country
by Barbara Blum
If you have ever traveled overseas, then returned to the U.S., you likely filled out a “customs declaration” form on the airplane:
“Are you bringing with you: plants, food, animals, soil, disease agents, cell cultures or snails? Declare all articles that you have acquired and are bringing into the United States.”
Who would have guessed the regulations would have been enforced so rigorously in 1969 when three men returned to the U.S. from a rather long business trip – to the moon and back. After more than 477,000 miles roundtrip, they had to file and sign a “General Declaration” for the items they acquired on the trip — specifically, “moon rock and moon dust samples.”
The flight number was typed in as “Apollo 11,” and the departure point was listed as “Moon” with arrival at Honolulu, Hawaii, U.S.A.
The Declaration of Health section, asks travelers to list: "Any other condition on board which may lead to the spread of disease.” The answer was “To be determined.”
(First-man-on-the-moon and former UC engineering professor Neil Armstrong died Aug. 25, 2012, at 82 years of age.)
Editor notes
:
Yes, the form really does ask if a person is bringing in snails.
Thanks to UC alumnus Luama Mays, JD ’66, for sharing a copy of the declaration with UC Magazine. Mays was a pilot who befriended Armstrong while the former astronaut was teaching at UC and Mays was running an aviation company. Initially Armstrong called him, without even identifying himself, asking for a ride on Mays old "bubble-style" helicopter left over from the Korean War. It was exactly what Armstrong had trained on in preparation for operating the lunar module.
(See entire story.)
Download the moon manifest pictured above.

data.title: CARA – High precision robot dog using rope
data.author: hakonjdjohnsen
data.article_summary: CARA是一款最新研发的四足机器人，采用缆索卷筒驱动，而非齿轮或滑轮。其关节通过绳索驱动，具有无反冲、高扭矩透明度、低惯性、低成本和安静运作的优点。为了实现精确的8:1齿轮比，作者通过实验和数值计算，最终成功设计出准确的传动比。CARA的腿部设计采用5杆联动机构，每个关节由8:1的缆索卷筒驱动，使用2毫米Dyneema DM20绳和Eaglepower 90KV BLDC电机，由ODrive S1 FOC控制器控制。机器人脚部由TPU 95A材料制成，小卷筒采用PET-CF材料打印，其余结构件则使用聚碳酸酯。整体设计强调独特性和高性能。

44661846.article_content:
CARA (07/11/2025)
Introduction
CARA (Capstans Are Really Awesome) is my latest quadrupedal robot, following
ZEUS
,
ARES
, and
TOPS
. Built over the course of a year, CARA is easily my most dynamic and well-designed quadruped yet. Unlike most quadrupeds, CARA doesn’t use any gears or pulleys. Instead, her joints are driven by rope through capstan drives. CARA is also the second quadruped ever to use capstan drives, following
Stanley
. If you’re unfamiliar with how capstan drives work, I’ve made a 20-minute video —
High Precision Speed Reducer Using Rope
— that explains everything you need to know. CARA builds directly on what I covered in that video. Capstan drives offer several advantages: zero backlash, high torque transparency, low inertia, low cost, and quiet operation. These qualities make them an ideal speed reducer for robotics.
Finding the Exact 8:1 Gear Ratio
The starting point of this project was figuring out how to achieve an exact 8:1 gear ratio with the capstan drives. In my capstan drive video, I designed all the drives to have an 8:1 gear ratio—but when measured, none of them actually did. The commenters on that video pretty accurately diagnosed my mistake. I had made the outer diameter of the big drum 8 times larger than the outer diameter of the small drum, but this doesn't account for the diameter of the rope. It's the same kind of oversight that led to
The SAT Question Everyone Got Wrong
in 1982. Instead of using the outer diameters, I should have used the effective diameters—the diameters that touch the centerline of the rope wrapped around the drums. The effective diameter of a drum is the same as the pitch diameter of a gear.
In theory, using the effective diameters should result in a perfect 8:1 gear ratio—but in practice, it's a bit more complicated. Since the rope is thin and flexible, measuring its exact diameter is tricky. It gets even harder when the rope is wrapped around the drum and put under tension, which slightly compresses it and reduces its diameter. While approximating the rope’s diameter can get you close to an 8:1 ratio, achieving true accuracy requires a numerical approach of calculation. First, I used the estimated rope diameter to build two capstan drives: one with a gear ratio slightly below 8:1 and one slightly above it. The measured gear ratios were 7.912:1 and 8.213:1, respectively. The only thing I changed between the two drives, to achieve the different gear ratios, was the outer diameters of the big drums. With the two known ratios and their corresponding outer drum diameters, I used linear interpolation to calculate the outer drum diameter that would produce an exact 8:1 ratio. I then built a third capstan drive using the interpolated value. The measured gear ratio on that drive was 8.000619:1, which confirmed the accuracy of the method. The CAD files for the 8:1 capstan drive test stand are available on my
Patreon Shop
and through my
Patreon Builder Tier
.
In theory, knowing the big drum diameter for the exact 8:1 drive should allow me to back-calculate the rope’s precise diameter, which I could then use to design other capstan drives with exact gear ratios. I have yet to confirm that this works.
Outer diameters of the drums
Effective diameters of the drums
Leg Design
CARA’s leg design is her most essential subassembly, so I spent more time designing a single leg than any other part of the robot. In the capstan drive video, I tested two different quadrupedal leg designs: a coaxial 5-bar linkage and a standard quadruped leg. I chose the 5-bar linkage for a few reasons. First, it distributes loads more evenly between its motors. Second, it's significantly more compact. And third, 5-bar linkage legs are heavily underutilized in quadrupeds. So, for the sake of uniqueness, I felt it was the best choice for CARA.
The leg has three joints: a, b, and ab/ad. Joints a and b belong to the 5-bar linkage, while the ab/ad joint rotates the entire linkage. Each joint is powered by an 8:1 capstan drive using
2 mm Dyneema DM20 Rope
, which has essentially zero creep. Each capstan drive is driven by an
Eaglepower 90KV BLDC Motor
. These pancake-shaped motors have large gap radiuses, which give them high torque—ideal for
Quasi-Direct Drive (QDD)
. Motor control is handled by
ODrive S1 FOC Controllers
. Since these boards have onboard magnetic encoders, they were mounted below the motor shafts. I attached
8 mm Encoder Magnets
to the motor shafts using custom 3D-printed couplers. I also designed custom 3D-printed ODrive covers with perforations for passive cooling.
The robot’s feet are made of two identical TPU 95A half-spheres, screwed onto the lower links of the 5-bar linkage. All small drums were printed in
PET-CF
, while the rest of the structural parts were printed in
Polycarbonate (PC)
. I chose PET-CF for the small drums because they experience the highest stress and PET-CF has higher strength compared to PC. In retrospect, it might have been better to print everything in
44661846.article_summary: CARA是一款最新研发的四足机器人，采用缆索卷筒驱动，而非齿轮或滑轮。其关节通过绳索驱动，具有无反冲、高扭矩透明度、低惯性、低成本和安静运作的优点。为了实现精确的8:1齿轮比，作者通过实验和数值计算，最终成功设计出准确的传动比。CARA的腿部设计采用5杆联动机构，每个关节由8:1的缆索卷筒驱动，使用2毫米Dyneema DM20绳和Eaglepower 90KV BLDC电机，由ODrive S1 FOC控制器控制。机器人脚部由TPU 95A材料制成，小卷筒采用PET-CF材料打印，其余结构件则使用聚碳酸酯。整体设计强调独特性和高性能。

data.article_summary: Bookhead是一款专为独立书店设计的软件，旨在帮助他们将实体店库存与在线书店无缝连接。通过自动同步库存和增强的书目数据，Bookhead让书店可以轻松地在多个平台（如Biblio、eBay、Squarespace）上销售书籍，而无需手动更新库存。该软件节省时间，减少繁琐操作，使书店能够专注于服务顾客。支持一键同步，简化在线销售流程，并计划 soon 支持Shopify。Bookhead让技术不再成为障碍，让书店有更多时间专注于书籍和顾客。目前处于测试阶段，早期注册可享受特别机会。

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：针对Perlin噪声优化的不同技术选择和观点，包括SIMD优化、GPU使用以及编译器相关问题。

不同观点：
• dragontamer认为，随着AVX和AVX512等新指令集的出现，重新审视Perlin噪声的优化是值得的。他提到GPU的SIMD也可以使用，但Perlin噪声问题较小，不一定值得通过PCIe传输。他还指出CUDA代码依然可以使用，但OpenCL是错误的选择。

• rincebrain关注编译器对性能的影响，提出不同编译器对内在函数生成的汇编代码性能差异较大，需要通过实际的汇编文件来获得一致的结果。

• jesse__作为文章作者，表示愿意回答任何问题，但未提出具体观点。

data.title: Checklists are hard, but still a good thing
data.author: zdw
data.article_summary: 本文解释了为何一些用户在访问博客"Wandering Thoughts"或其所属的wiki "CSpace"时被阻止。原因在于为减少高流量爬虫（尤其是为LLM训练收集数据）的负荷，作者实施了反爬虫措施，这些措施可能误将使用过时浏览器版本的用户识别为爬虫。如果用户认为被误判，可以联系作者提供所用浏览器的详细信息。特别是通过archive.*网站（如archive.today、archive.ph）访问的用户，因这些网站使用类似恶意爬虫的方式存档页面，也可能会被阻止，建议使用行为更规范的archive.org进行访问。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点： checklists在业务流程自动化、各行业应用及其局限性、以及如何有效实施和改进等方面的价值和挑战。

不同观点：
• **ww520**：主张在业务流程自动化前，先通过手动步骤和清单方式明确流程，识别痛点后再进行自动化，认为这样能简化自动化过程。
• **dvt**：强调清单在许多行业中未被充分利用，尤其是在高风险行业如航空和军事中效果显著。但要在更多行业推广，需要进行运营层面的变革，且说服管理层投资于清单可能存在阻力。
• **blakehaswell**：介绍了清单的两种使用方式——“读后做”和“做后确认”，指出后者在航空等行业中的应用更为高效，且操作负担低。
• **vorgol**：通过引述Tim Harford的播客，举例说明清单可能在历史事故如1981年堪萨斯城酒店天桥坍塌事故中起到预防作用。
• **regnull**：分享了自己对清单的长期兴趣，并推出了“增强版”清单应用，邀请反馈。
• **rapfaria**：指出清单和算法在实际操作中难以完全详尽，举例烹饪和编程中存在的模糊指令问题。
• **zhaohan_dong**：作为飞行员推崇清单，但在软件工程中推广困难，因为软件环境的变化更快且错误成本较低。
• **kqr**：区分了清单和待办事项列表，强调清单是针对标准程序，而待办事项列表是针对特定任务集合。
• **squeedles**：通过Ansible的例子，说明描述“已知良好”状态并运行清单可以记录和评估流程。
• **azmarks**：推荐Atul Gawande的《清单宣言》一书，认为其为清单的价值提供了深入见解。
• **cadamsdotcom**：建议逐步自动化清单中的步骤，从简单部分开始，逐步细化和自动化复杂部分。
• **ChrisMarshallNY**：提到以前公司使用庞大的Excel清单，有时包含上千项。
• **GuB-42**：提出“不检查清单”的概念，用于避免在打包等场景中过度准备不必要的物品。
• **gleb**：认为编写有效清单非常困难，需要编程和文案写作技能，且确保人们实际使用清单和不断改进系统更加困难。
• **shooker435**：分享了自己曾经参与的基于清单的业务项目。

补充讨论：
• **清单的价值和应用场景**：讨论中多次提到清单在高风险行业如航空、军事中的成功应用，但也指出在其他行业推广时可能面临的阻力和挑战。
• **清单的类型和使用方式**：blakehaswell详细介绍了“读后做”和“做后确认”两种清单使用方式，强调后者在效率和操作负担上的优势。
• **清单的局限性和改进**：gleb指出编写和使用清单的困难，而GuB-42则提出“不检查清单”的概念以应对清单过度复杂的问题。
• **自动化与清单的关系**：多位评论者提到清单可以作为自动化的基础，ww520和cadamsdotcom建议通过手动执行清单识别痛点后再逐步自动化，而squeedles通过Ansible的例子说明自动化清单的实践。

争议焦点：清单在各行业推广中的阻力和挑战，以及如何有效编写和使用清单以确保其实际效果。

44626359.article_content:
You're using a suspiciously old browser
You're probably reading this page because you've attempted to access
some part of
my blog (Wandering Thoughts)
or
CSpace
, the wiki thing it's part of. Unfortunately
you're using a browser version that my anti-crawler precautions consider
suspicious, most often because it's too old (most often this applies to
versions of Chrome). Unfortunately, as of early 2025 there's a plague
of high volume crawlers (apparently in part to gather data for LLM
training) that use a variety of old browser user agents, especially
Chrome user agents. To reduce the load on
Wandering Thoughts
I'm experimenting with
(attempting to) block all of them, and you've run into this.
If this is in error and you're using a current version of your
browser of choice, you can contact me at
my current place at the
university
(you should be able to work out the email address
from that). If possible, please let me know what browser you're
using and so on, ideally with its exactl User-Agent string.
A special note for people using archive.*
You may be seeing this through archive.today, archive.ph, archive.is,
and so on. Unfortunately, archive.* crawls pages to archive in a way that
is impossible to distinguish from malicious actors. They use old Chrome
User-Agent values, crawl from IP address blocks that are widely distributed
and not clearly identified as theirs, and some of their IP addresses have
falsified reverse DNS entries that claim they are googlebot IP addresses
(which is something that is normally done only by quite bad actors). I
suggest that you use archive.org, which is a better behaved archival
crawler and can crawl
my blog (Wandering Thoughts)
.
Chris Siebenmann, 2025-02-17

data.title: Interactive Programming in C (2014)
data.author: ofalkaed
data.article_summary: 这篇文章介绍了如何在C语言中实现交互式编程，即在程序运行时修改和扩展功能。这种方法特别适用于游戏开发等非批处理应用，可以减少调试和调整的繁琐过程。关键技巧是将几乎整个应用程序构建为共享库（shared library），并且避免在全局或静态变量中保存状态。文章通过一个简单的“生命游戏”示例演示了这种方法：编辑代码后，无需重启程序，修改会立即生效。共享库通过一个结构体（struct）封装的API与主程序交互，避免使用函数指针产生的问题。这种技术可以在Linux等类Unix系统上使用libdl实现，类似于Windows上的DLL方法。文章还详细介绍了API的五个主要函数：`init()`、`finalize()`、`reload()`、`unload()`和`step()`，用于处理状态初始化、资源释放和动态加载。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：热代码重载（hot code reloading）在不同情境下的实现与应用

不同观点：
• **lkuty**：提到Tsoding在C语言中实现了热代码重载，并在他制作的"My Own 3b1b Animation Engine but in C"项目中也应用了相同概念，提供了视频链接展示实现方法。

• **mrheosuper**：指出HolyC是一种解释语言，暗示其可能与讨论中的C语言热重载有所不同。

• **zoom6628**：提出Ballard等人的TinyC也可以作为C语言解释器使用，可能适用于热代码重载的实现。

• **RustyRussell**：介绍了Andrew Tridgell的KnightCap项目，该项目通过将数据转储到文件并重新执行实现热重载，特别提到这种方法能够在网络服务器环境中保持文件描述符（fds）的开放以实现零停机时间。

• **uticus**：关注热代码重载中的错误处理策略，建议在库加载无误时查找GAME_API结构，若查找失败则关闭句柄并视为失败，强调了错误处理和状态回退的重要性。

• **90s_dev**：分享了自己曾经为Love2D开发的VS Code扩展"live2d"的经历，虽然实现了热重载功能，但由于使用难度高且缺乏关注而放弃，并提到自己发明的"magic tables"来辅助使用。

补充讨论：
• 热代码重载在不同编程语言和环境下的实现方式不同，如HolyC的解释语言特性、TinyC作为C解释器的潜力、以及KnightCap通过数据转储和重新执行实现热重载。
• 讨论中涉及了热代码重载的实际应用问题，如错误处理、状态回退、以及在网络服务器环境中的零停机时间实现。
• 个人项目经验分享，如90s_dev的"live2d"扩展，提供了对热重载功能开发过程中遇到的挑战和解决方案的见解。

争议焦点：
• 不同实现方法的适用性和复杂性，如HolyC的解释语言特性是否适合热重载、TinyC作为C解释器的可行性等。

44661607.article_content:
Interactive Programming in C
December 23, 2014
nullprogram.com/blog/2014/12/23/
I’m a huge fan of interactive programming (see:
JavaScript
,
Java
,
Lisp
,
Clojure
). That is, modifying and
extending a program while it’s running. For certain kinds of non-batch
applications, it takes much of the tedium out of testing and tweaking
during development. Until last week I didn’t know how to apply
interactive programming to C. How does one go about redefining
functions in a running C program?
Last week in
Handmade Hero
(days 21-25), Casey Muratori added
interactive programming to the game engine. This is especially useful
in game development, where the developer might want to tweak, say, a
boss fight without having to restart the entire game after each tweak.
Now that I’ve seen it done, it seems so obvious.
The secret is to
build almost the entire application as a shared library.
This puts a serious constraint on the design of the program:
it
cannot keep any state in global or static variables
, though this
should be avoided anyway
. Global state will be lost each
time the shared library is reloaded. In some situations, this can also
restrict use of the C standard library, including functions like
malloc()
, depending on how these functions are implemented or
linked. For example, if the C standard library is statically linked,
functions with global state may introduce global state into the shared
library. It’s difficult to know what’s safe to use. This works fine in
Handmade Hero because the core game, the part loaded as a shared
library, makes no use of external libraries, including the standard
library.
Additionally, the shared library must be careful with its use of
function pointers. The functions being pointed at will no longer exist
after a reload. This is a real issue when combining interactive
programming with
object oriented C
.
An example with the Game of Life
To demonstrate how this works, let’s go through an example. I wrote a
simple ncurses Game of Life demo that’s easy to modify. You can get
the entire source here if you’d like to play around with it yourself
on a Unix-like system.
https://github.com/skeeto/interactive-c-demo
Quick start
:
In a terminal run
make
then
./main
. Press
r
randomize and
q
to quit.
Edit
game.c
to change the Game of Life rules, add colors, etc.
In a second terminal run
make
. Your changes will be reflected
immediately in the original program!
As of this writing, Handmade Hero is being written on Windows, so
Casey is using a DLL and the Win32 API, but the same technique can be
applied on Linux, or any other Unix-like system, using libdl. That’s
what I’ll be using here.
The program will be broken into two parts: the Game of Life shared
library (“game”) and a wrapper (“main”) whose job is only to load the
shared library, reload it when it updates, and call it at a regular
interval. The wrapper is agnostic about the operation of the “game”
portion, so it could be re-used almost untouched in another project.
To avoid maintaining a whole bunch of function pointer assignments in
several places, the API to the “game” is enclosed in a struct. This
also eliminates warnings from the C compiler about mixing data and
function pointers. The layout and contents of the
game_state
struct is private to the game itself. The wrapper will only handle a
pointer to this struct.
struct
game_state
;
struct
game_api
{
struct
game_state
*
(
*
init
)();
void
(
*
finalize
)(
struct
game_state
*
state
);
void
(
*
reload
)(
struct
game_state
*
state
);
void
(
*
unload
)(
struct
game_state
*
state
);
bool
(
*
step
)(
struct
game_state
*
state
);
};
In the demo the API is made of 5 functions. The first 4 are primarily
concerned with loading and unloading.
init()
: Allocate and return a state to be passed to every other
API call. This will be called once when the program starts and never
again, even after reloading. If we were concerned about using
malloc()
in the shared library, the wrapper would be responsible
for performing the actual memory allocation.
finalize()
: The opposite of
init()
, to free all resources held
by the game state.
reload()
: Called immediately after the library is reloaded. This
is the chance to sneak in some additional initialization in the
running program. Normally this function will be empty. It’s only
used temporarily during development.
unload()
: Called just before the library is unloaded, before a new
version is loaded. This is a chance to prepare the state for use by
the next version of the library. This can be used to update structs
and such, if you wanted to be really careful. This would also
normally be empty.
step()
: Called at a regular interval to run the game. A real game
will likely have a few more functions like this.
The library will provide a filled out API struct as a global variable,
GAME_API
.
This is the only exported symbol in the entire shared
library!
All functions will be declared static, including the ones
referenced by the structure.
const

44661607.article_summary: 这篇文章介绍了如何在C语言中实现交互式编程，即在程序运行时修改和扩展功能。这种方法特别适用于游戏开发等非批处理应用，可以减少调试和调整的繁琐过程。关键技巧是将几乎整个应用程序构建为共享库（shared library），并且避免在全局或静态变量中保存状态。文章通过一个简单的“生命游戏”示例演示了这种方法：编辑代码后，无需重启程序，修改会立即生效。共享库通过一个结构体（struct）封装的API与主程序交互，避免使用函数指针产生的问题。这种技术可以在Linux等类Unix系统上使用libdl实现，类似于Windows上的DLL方法。文章还详细介绍了API的五个主要函数：`init()`、`finalize()`、`reload()`、`unload()`和`step()`，用于处理状态初始化、资源释放和动态加载。

Many cities face the following problem. They have railway lines that go where people live. But these railway lines end at the edge of the city center, and don’t go out the other side.
For cities with this problem, the solution is
through running
. Terminating a train and turning it around takes a lot of space, space that is usually unavailable in a city center. This means running a railway line through the city often doubles or triples the number of trains it can handle. As a bonus, passengers who are going from one side of the city to the other can do that much more quickly, with no change.
Many cities, such as London, Paris, Munich and Milan, have used through running to turn some of their existing Victorian railway lines into metro-style services, by building tunnels under the city center. A few other cities, like Berlin, built viaducts (bridges that carry roads and railways over obstacles), while others, such as Cologne, have simply added platforms at their main stations to enable suburban trains to run through. But all of these are big cities, with over a million people, where the property value uplift or extra revenues from fares can cover
the enormous costs
of tunneling. But there is another option, affordable for smaller cities or large towns: the
tram-train
.
A Karlsruhe tram, running on railway tracks. Image credit:
Baden-Wuerttemberg
.
Karlsruhe is a small city of only 300,000 people in southwestern Germany, near the French border. The city’s main station is nearly two kilometers from the city center, following a project in the early twentieth century to build a larger station on a less cramped site. This caused great inconvenience to passengers, who had to change to the city’s tram network in order to get to the old center.
In 1957, the city took the first steps towards creating a new type of transit, the tram-train, when it took over a bankrupt suburban railway, the Albtalbahn, and extended it into the city center over the tram network.
Over the next four years the line’s gauge (the space between the rails) was converted from 1,000 millimeters to 1,435 millimeters, the standard gauge used by the tram network, and it was re-electrified at the same voltage as the tramway. The modernization of the line enabled quicker journey times – the 70 minute journey to Bad Herrenalb, the line’s terminus, was reduced to 46 minutes – but more importantly passengers who wanted to get to the city center did not need to change to a tram.
The idea of a tram that runs outside of a city’s urban area was not new: Vienna, for instance, had been operating a similar line to the neighboring spa town of Baden since 1907. Karlsruhe’s inventive step, which came later, was to extend the tram-train onto railway lines that did not just carry tram traffic. In 1979, the line was extended onto a freight railway north of the city, and in 1992 the first tram-train took over pre-existing passenger services, to the town of Bretten.
Joining the tram and train networks together was
tricky
. German railways are electrified at 15 kilovolts alternating current, while Karlsruhe’s trams use 750 volt direct current, which meant that the city needed to procure trams capable of using both voltages, which were (and still are) rare. The railway and the tram network used two different signaling systems, the ‘traffic lights’ that are used to control the movement of rail traffic. The trams have to use
retractable steps
to overcome the big gap between the 2.65 meter-wide trams and platforms which can handle 3 meter-wide trains. These steps also enable later models of the trams, whose floors are 570 millimeters above the ground, to work with both 380 and 760 millimeter-high platforms.
Overcoming these technical problems led to a much better network.
Ridership of the Bretten line went up 400 percent
after it was extended into the city center on tramlines, and the line now has
18,000 trips per day
, up from 2,000 before the tram-train took over. Passenger numbers on the network
doubled
between 1985 and 1999, after several more lines had been added. The network today, which carries
170 million passengers
per year, is over 660 kilometers long, longer than the combined length of Munich’s tram, metro and suburban railway networks.
Karlruhe’s transit system. Image credit:
Wikimedia Commons.
Tram-trains have trade-offs. Trams are
slower than trains
, because they have to share road space with cars, pedestrians and bicycles. Where possible, therefore, Karls

data.title: A diverse cast of rocky worlds around a small star revealed by astronomers
data.author: layer8
data.article_summary: 一支由蒙特利尔大学和特罗蒂尔外行星研究所（IREx）领导的团队对L 98-59行星系统进行了最精确的研究，确认该系统中存在第五颗可能宜居的行星。L 98-59是一颗距离地球35光年的红矮星，拥有多颗岩质行星。通过重新分析地面和太空望远镜的数据，研究团队精确测定了这些行星的质量和大小。其中，第五颗行星L 98-59 f位于宜居区，可能存在液态水。该系统包含多种类型的行星，包括可能有极端火山活动的行星和富含水的“水世界”行星。研究利用了NASA的TESS和ESO的HARPS、ESPRESSO等望远镜的数据，展示了结合太空和地面观测的力量，为未来利用詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜（JWST）研究行星大气提供了重要目标。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：新确认的宜居带行星及其相关背景

不同观点：
• Layer8分享了一则关于新确认的位于宜居带的第五颗行星的消息，并提供了相关研究的链接。这表明了对天文学新发现的关注，强调了科学研究成果的发布。

• Tepix指出了该行星距离地球仅35光年，暗示这个距离在天文学上相对较近，可能意味着未来探索的可能性。

• Searine提供了该研究资金来源的详细信息，强调了该项目是由加拿大政府机构、美国NASA项目以及欧洲南方天文台的望远镜时间等多方资助完成的。这表明了对科研资金来源的关注。

• Osti以幽默的方式提出了是否应该派遣像马特·达蒙（参考电影《火星救援》）这样的任务。这反映了对人类探索外星世界可能性的调侃和兴趣。

44661862.article_content:
A team led by UdeM researchers confirms a fifth potentially habitable planet around L 98-59, a red dwarf 35 light-years away.
A team led by the Trottier Institute for Research on Exoplanets (IREx) at the Université de Montréal has achieved the most precise study to date of the L 98-59 planetary system, and confirmed the existence of a fifth planet in the star’s habitable zone, where conditions could allow liquid water to exist.
Volcanic planets, a sub-Earth, and a water world
Charles Cadieux, the IREx researcher who led the study on the L 98-59 system. Courtesy photo
Credit: Courtesy
L 98-59, a small red dwarf located just 35 light-years from Earth, hosts three small transiting exoplanets discovered in 2019, thanks to
NASA's TESS space telescope
, and a fourth planet revealed through radial velocity measurements with the
European Southern Observatory's ESPRESSO spectrograph
. All four planets orbit their parent star in a compact orbital configuration, all at distances five times closer than Mercury is to the Sun.
By carefully reanalyzing a rich set of observations from ground-based and space-based telescopes, a team led by Université de Montréal and Trottier Institute for Research on Exoplanets (IREx) researcher
Charles Cadieux
has determined the planets’ sizes and masses with unprecedented precision.
“These new results paint the most complete picture we’ve ever had of the fascinating L 98-59 system,” said Cadieux. “It’s a powerful demonstration of what we can achieve by combining data from space telescopes and high-precision instruments on Earth, and it gives us key targets for future atmospheric studies with the
James Webb Space Telescope
[JWST].”
All planets in the system have masses and sizes compatible with the terrestrial regime. The innermost planet, L 98-59 b, is only 84% of Earth’s size and about half its mass, making it one of the rare sub-Earths known with well-measured parameters.
The two inner planets may experience extreme volcanic activity due to tidal heating, similar to Jupiter’s volcanic Moon, Io, in the Solar System. Meanwhile, the third, unusually low in density, may be a “water world,” a planet enriched in water unlike anything in our Solar System.
The refined measurements reveal nearly perfectly circular orbits for the inner planets, a favourable configuration for future atmospheric detections.
“With its diversity of rocky worlds and range of planetary compositions, L 98-59 offers a unique laboratory to address some of the field’s most pressing questions: What are super-Earths and sub-Neptunes made of? Do planets form differently around small stars? Can rocky planets around red dwarfs retain atmospheres over time?” adds
René Doyon
, co-author of the study, who is a professor at UdeM and the Director of IREx.
A fifth planet in the habitable zone
One of the key breakthroughs of this study is the confirmation of a fifth planet in the L 98-59 system. This planet, designated L 98-59 f, does not transit its host star — meaning it doesn’t pass directly between us and the star — but its presence was revealed through subtle variations in the star’s motion, detected using radial velocity measurements from HARPS (
High Accuracy Radial velocity Planet Searcher
) and ESPRESSO data.
L 98-59 f receives about the same amount of stellar energy as Earth does from the Sun, placing it firmly within the temperate, or habitable zone, a region where water could remain in liquid form.
“Finding a temperate planet in such a compact system makes this discovery particularly exciting,” said Cadieux. “It highlights the remarkable diversity of exoplanetary systems and strengthens the case for studying potentially habitable worlds around low-mass stars.”
This study exploits data from two ground-based telescopes: the Very Large Telescope (top left, credit: ESO/G. Hüdepohl) and the ESO 3.6-metre telescope, with the HARPS instrument (top right, credit: ESO), as well as two space telescopes: TESS and JWST, shown here in artistic representations, respectively, bottom right and bottom left.
Credit: NASA

Hüdepohl) and the ESO 3.6-metre telescope, with the HARPS instrument (top right, credit: ESO), as well as two space telescopes: TESS and JWST, shown here in artistic representations, respectively, bottom right and bottom left.

data.title: Parsing Protobuf like never before
data.author: ibobev
data.article_summary: 本文介绍了作者在Protobuf解析性能优化方面的工作，特别是新开发的Go语言库——**hyperpb**。传统Protobuf解析器通过生成特定类型的源代码来实现高性能，但这存在一些缺点，如需预先编译所有类型、增加指令缓存负担等。作者提到的**UPB**是一个动态Protobuf解析库，通过数据表和解释器VM实现高效解析。然而，由于Go语言的C FFI性能较差，作者开发了**hyperpb**，将UPB的许多优化引入Go，并针对Go的特性进行调整。结果显示，hyperpb在多项基准测试中超越了其他Go Protobuf解析器，包括Protobuf Go生成的代码和vtprotobuf。文章还讨论了Go语言的独特特性如何为Protobuf解析器带来有趣的优化机会，如寄存器ABI和反射系统。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Protobuf解析库的设计与优化，特别是涉及编译器、虚拟机（VM）、性能优化等方面的问题。

不同观点：
• **nemo1618**：提出两种看法。第一种观点认为，如果一个编解码器的解析库包含编译器、VM和PGO，那么这个编解码器可能设计不当，开发者应反思。第二种观点则认为，这种复杂的结构也可能意味着该编解码器非常流行且具有巨大价值。

• **skybrian**：赞赏了对Go内部机制的深入描述，并提到Go团队可能没有特别关注快速解释器的使用场景。如果这种优化能使Protobuf解析更快，可能会引起更多关注，并减少对低级技巧的依赖。

• **AceJohnny2**：偏离主题地提到CapnProto，并询问其使用情况及与Protobuf的比较，特别是Cloudflare Workers中的使用情况。

• **UncleEntity**：对Protobuf消息解析中使用VM的细节感到困惑，讨论了为特定Protobuf消息类型定制的VM与通用VM的区别，并分享了自己在二进制解析系统设计中的经验。

• **cryptonector**：询问并确认hyperpb是否将Protobuf类型编译成类似于AST的结构并在运行时解释。提到ASN.1编译器的类似做法，并解释这种方法的优化效果。

• **alexozer**：尝试识别这种设计背后的瓶颈，指出Go FFI的缓慢和每种生成代码的专业化可能导致的icache压力是主要动机。

• **ryukoposting**：提到nanopb，并质疑其在不同解析器中的基准表现，指出nanopb在嵌入式代码中的广泛使用。

• **dang**：提到相关的讨论线程，提供更多背景信息。

• **mdhb**：希望将Protobuf的优点引入标准化序列化格式如CBOR，并提到gRPC-web与标准如WHATWG streams和WebTransport的结合。

• **spenczar5**：提到JITting字节码VM在类似情况下的优秀表现，并指出模式文档本质上是程序，编译后的程序更快。

• **tschellenbach**：分享了自己之前对msgpack和Protobuf的基准测试结果，发现JSON更慢，但msgpack和Protobuf表现接近。

• **karel-3d**：表达了阅读讨论后产生的冒名顶替综合症。

• **jeffrallen**：对hyperpb库的复杂设计表示幽默的评论。

• **irq-1**：提供hyperpb库的GitHub链接。

• **ptspts**：询问hyperpb与其他Protobuf解析器的基准比较。

补充讨论：
• 讨论中多次提到不同序列化格式（如Protobuf、CapnProto、JSON、msgpack）的性能比较，以及在各种使用场景中的适用性。
• 对Go语言在编写快速解释器方面的能力和局限性进行了讨论，特别是FFI和icache压力的问题。
• 涉及具体技术如AST解释、模板解释、JITting字节码VM等的实现细节和优化效果。

争议焦点：
• 使用包含编译器、VM和PGO的复杂结构是否合理，或是过度优化。
• 不同Protobuf解析库和格式的性能基准比较，特别是hyperpb的实际效果如何。

总的来说，讨论围绕Protobuf解析库的设计优化展开，涉及多种技术方案的比较和实际应用中的性能问题。

Parsing Protobuf Like Never Before
Historically I have worked on many projects related to high-performance Protobuf, be that on the C++ runtime, on the Rust runtime, or on integrating
UPB
, the fastest Protobuf runtime, written by my colleague
Josh Haberman
. I
generally
don’t post directly about my current job, but my most recent toy-turned-product is something I’m very excited to write about:
hyperpb
.
Here’s how we measure up against other Go Protobuf parsers. This is a subset of my benchmarks, since the benchmark suite contains many dozens of specimens. This was recorded on an AMD Zen 4 machine.
Throughput for various configurations of
hyperpb
(colored bars) vs. competing parsers (grey bars). Each successive
hyperpb
includes all previous optimizations, corresponding to
zerocopy mode
,
arena reuse
, and
profile-guided optimization
. Bigger is better.
Traditionally, Protobuf backends would generate parsers by generating source code specialized to each type. Naively, this would give the best performance, because everything would be “right-sized” to a particular message type. Unfortunately, now that we know better, there are a bunch of drawbacks:
Every type you care about must be compiled ahead-of-time. Tricky for when you want to build something generic over schemas your users provide you.
Every type contributes to a cost on the instruction cache, meaning that if your program parses a lot of different types, it will essentially flush your instruction cache any time you enter a parser. Worse still, if a parse involves enough types, the parser itself will hit instruction decoding throughput issues.
These effects are not directly visible in normal workloads, but other side-effects are visible: for example, giant switches on field numbers can turn into chains of branch instructions, meaning that higher-numbered fields will be quite slow. Even binary-searching on field numbers isn’t exactly ideal. However, we know that every Protobuf codec ever emits fields in index order (i.e., declaration order in the
.proto
file), which is a data conditioning fact we don’t take advantage of with a switch.
UPB solves this problem. It is a small C kernel for parsing Protobuf messages, which is completely dynamic: a UPB “parser” is actually a collection of data tables that are evaluated by a
table-driven parser
. In other words, a UPB parser is actually configuration for an interpreter VM, which executes Protobuf messages as its bytecode. UPB also contains many arena optimizations to improve allocation throughput when parsing complex messages.
hyperpb
is a brand new library, written in the most cursed Go imaginable, which brings many of the optimizations of UPB to Go, and many new ones, while being tuned to Go’s own weird needs. The result leaves the competition in the dust in virtually every benchmark, while being completely runtime-dynamic. This means it’s faster than Protobuf Go’s own generated code,
and
vtprotobuf
(a popular but non-conforming
1
parser generator for Go).
This post is about some of the internals of
hyperpb
. I have also prepared a more sales-ey writeup, which you can read on
the Buf blog
.
Why Reinvent UPB?
UPB is awesome. It can slot easily into any language that has C FFI, which is basically every language ever.
Unfortunately, Go’s C FFI is really, really bad. It’s hard to overstate how bad cgo is. There isn’t a good way to cooperate with C on memory allocation (C can’t really handle Go memory without a lot of problems, due to the GC). Having C memory get cleaned up by the GC requires finalizers, which are very slow. Calling into C is very slow, because Go pessimistically assumes that C requires a large stack, and also calling into C does nasty things to the scheduler.
All of these things can be worked around, of course. For a while I considered compiling UPB to assembly, and rewriting that assembly into Go’s awful assembly syntax
2
, and then having Go assemble UPB out of that. This presents a few issues though, particularly because Go’s assembly calling convention is still in the stone age
3
(arguments are passed on the stack), and because we would still need to do a lot of work to get UPB to match the
protoreflect
API.
Go also has a few… unique qualities that make writing a Protobuf interpreter an interesting challenge with
exciting
optimization opportunities.
First, of course, is the register ABI, which on
x86_64
gives us a whopping
nine
argument and return registers, meaning that we can simply pass the entire parser state in registers all the time.
Second is that Go does not have much UB to speak of, so we can get away with a lot of very evil pointer crimes that we could not in C++ or Rust.
Third is that Protobuf Go has a robust reflection system that we can target if we des

data.title: Show HN: TheProtector – Linux Bash script for the paranoid admin on a budget
data.author: lotussmellsbad
data.article_summary: **theProtector** 是一个针对预算有限但高度关注安全的Linux管理员设计的Bash脚本工具，提供实时监控和主动威胁响应功能。它监控系统进程、网络连接、文件变更、用户活动及系统资源使用情况，并通过eBPF（如果可用）进行内核级监控。威胁响应包括自动阻止恶意IP、终止可疑进程、隔离恶意软件并恢复关键系统文件。此外，它还具备YARA规则扫描、行为基线学习、反逃避技术和蜜罐服务等高级检测功能。该工具提供Web仪表盘、JSON输出、综合日志记录及警报分类，并可通过cron实现自动化监控。安装简单，依赖标准Linux工具，同时也支持可选的高级功能依赖如YARA、jq等。使用该工具需要root权限和基本的系统资源。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：一个名为TheProtector（或Ghost Sentinel）的Bash脚本安全工具的实现、安全性、功能性及可信度。

不同观点：
• **支持与赞赏**：
  - monch1962：赞赏该工具的实用性，尤其是Bash的广泛适用性和Linux管理员对Bash的熟悉程度，认为该工具在未保护的Linux服务器上非常有用。同时也建议增加更多关于通知框架的文档。
  - xalg：简单且易于部署，已经将其添加到测试服务器上。
  - ropable：认为该Bash脚本短小精悍，可以在短时间内全面评估，对作者表示赞赏。

• **安全问题与改进建议**：
  - panphora：认可工具的功能，但指出多个安全问题，包括命令注入风险、Python脚本在/tmp目录下的权限提升问题。建议使用root拥有的目录替代/tmp，并提供了Gmail配置的解决方案。同时提出性能优化建议，如在资源受限的VPS实例上禁用eBPF功能。
  - FergusArgyll：建议删除自我更新功能，以避免潜在的安全风险。
  - bugsMarathon88：质疑该工具的可靠性和安全性，认为其缺乏作者归属、独立安全审查、功能验证及文档，并指出执行超级用户权限的合理性问题，建议增加实验性声明。

• **技术与设计讨论**：
  - _QrE：质疑将所有功能打包到一个Bash脚本中的必要性，认为可以使用其他已有的安全工具来实现类似功能。
  - vanviegen：赞赏工具的功能和可读性，但对其作者的匿名性表示担忧，认为可能会引起用户的安全顾虑。
  - webprofusion：对工具的AI构建表示兴趣，并希望了解所使用的提示。

• **其他意见**：
  - globalnode：表示对Linux安全工具的需求，并寻求学习建议。
  - _def：质疑工具是否使用LLM构建。
  - rfkjrjr：询问thelotus的身份。

补充讨论：
• **争议焦点**：
  - 安全性：特别是命令注入和权限提升问题。
  - 文档和透明度：包括功能验证、文档缺乏及作者匿名性问题。
• **工具实用性**：
  - 支持者认为该工具实用且易于部署。
  - 批评者则认为其设计过于复杂，且缺乏必要的文档和审查。

总体而言，讨论围绕工具的功能、安全性、文档及作者透明度展开，体现了用户对安全工具的高标准要求。

theProtector
Linux Bash Script for the Paranoid Admin on a Budget - real-time monitoring and active threat response
TheProtector
Linux security tool for the paranoid on a budget - not perfect but better than most
TheProtector is comprehensive security monitoring for Linux systems. Built for DEfense Only
What It Does
TheProtector monitors your Linux system in real-time and actively responds to threats:
Real-time Monitoring:
Process execution and behavior analysis
Network connections and traffic patterns
File system changes and integrity checking
User activity and privilege escalation attempts
System resource usage and anomalies
Kernel-level activity via eBPF (when available)
Active Threat Response:
Automatically blocks malicious IP addresses
Terminates suspicious processes immediately
Quarantines detected malware with forensic preservation
Restores modified critical system files from backups
Kills reverse shell connections and C2 communications
Advanced Detection:
YARA rule scanning for malware signatures
Behavioral baseline learning and anomaly detection
Anti-evasion techniques to defeat rootkits and process hiding
Honeypot services to detect reconnaissance attempts
Threat intelligence integration with automatic updates
Management Interface:
Web dashboard for real-time monitoring
JSON output for SIEM integration
Comprehensive logging with integrity verification
Alert categorization by severity level
Historical analysis and reporting
Installation
Quick Start
curl -O https://raw.githubusercontent.com/IHATEGIVINGAUSERNAME/theProtector/main/theprotector.sh
chmod +x theprotector.sh
sudo ./theprotector.sh
test
Full Installation
#
Download the script
wget https://raw.githubusercontent.com/IHATEGIVINGAUSERNAME/theProtector/main/theprotector.sh
#
Make executable
chmod +x theprotector.sh
#
Run initial setup and test
sudo ./theprotector.sh
test
#
Install for automatic monitoring
sudo ./theprotector.sh install
Dependencies
Required (Standard on all Linux systems)
bash (4.0 or higher)
curl or wget
awk, grep, sed
netstat or ss
iptables
cron (for scheduled scans)
Optional (Enables advanced features)
yara
- Malware signature scanning
jq
- JSON processing and pretty output
inotify-tools
- Real-time file monitoring
netcat
- Network honeypot services
bcc-tools
- eBPF kernel monitoring (requires root)
Install Optional Dependencies
Ubuntu/Debian:
sudo apt update
sudo apt install yara jq inotify-tools netcat-openbsd
#

44662497.article_summary: **theProtector** 是一个针对预算有限但高度关注安全的Linux管理员设计的Bash脚本工具，提供实时监控和主动威胁响应功能。它监控系统进程、网络连接、文件变更、用户活动及系统资源使用情况，并通过eBPF（如果可用）进行内核级监控。威胁响应包括自动阻止恶意IP、终止可疑进程、隔离恶意软件并恢复关键系统文件。此外，它还具备YARA规则扫描、行为基线学习、反逃避技术和蜜罐服务等高级检测功能。该工具提供Web仪表盘、JSON输出、综合日志记录及警报分类，并可通过cron实现自动化监控。安装简单，依赖标准Linux工具，同时也支持可选的高级功能依赖如YARA、jq等。使用该工具需要root权限和基本的系统资源。
44662497.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：一个名为TheProtector（或Ghost Sentinel）的Bash脚本安全工具的实现、安全性、功能性及可信度。

不同观点：
• **支持与赞赏**：

  - panphora：认可工具的功能，但指出多个安全问题，包括命令注入风险、Python脚本在/tmp目录下的权限提升问题。建议使用root拥有的目录替代/tmp，并提供了Gmail配置的解决方案。同时提出性能优化建议，如在资源受限的VPS实例上禁用eBPF功能。

• **技术与设计讨论**：
  - _QrE：质疑将所有功能打包到一个Bash脚本中的必要性，认为可以使用其他已有的安全工具来实现类似功能。
  - vanviegen：赞赏工具的功能和可读性，但对其作者的匿名性表示担忧，认为可能会引起用户的安全顾虑。
  - webprofusion：对工具的AI构建表示兴趣，并希望了解所使用的提示。

• **其他意见**：
  - globalnode：表示对Linux安全工具的需求，并寻求学习建议。
  - _def：质疑工具是否使用LLM构建。
  - rfkjrjr：询问thelotus的身份。

总体而言，讨论围绕工具的功能、安全性、文档及作者透明度展开，体现了用户对安全工具的高标准要求。

data.title: Robot scans rare library books at 2.5k pages per hour
data.author: bookofjoe
data.article_summary: 文章主要介绍了一种名为ScanRobot 2.0的机器人，其设计目的是帮助图书馆和档案馆更高效地数字化珍贵书籍。传统的手工扫描方法耗时长且需要小心操作，而ScanRobot 2.0通过使用气流和真空技术，能够自动翻页并快速扫描，每小时可处理多达2,500页。该机器人由奥地利公司Treventus制造，利用楔形摄像装置扫描书籍中心，并通过气流翻页。尽管自动化程度高，但仍需专业人员监控操作。塔尔萨大学的McFarlin图书馆已采用该技术，计划将数万本已过版权期的书籍数字化，供学生和学者使用。

The ScanRobot 2.0 uses gentle puffs of air to turn a book's pages. Credit: Treventus

For decades, preservationists charged with digitizing
rare books
have faced an ironic challenge. The whole point of scanning these often
one-of-a-kind objects
is to keep the delicate manuscripts from harm. To do that, however, required a much more hands-on approach.
One of the first solutions was to simply place a tome in a book cradle, then photograph each individual page. In later years, archivists increasingly relied on more advanced top-down document camera arrays. Even today, the digitization process is frequently tedious and time-consuming work—and that’s where specially designed robots come in handy.
After two years of research, archivists at the University of Tulsa’s McFarlin Library
recently decided
to try out a machine called the
Treventus ScanRobot 2.0
. Built in Austria, the bot does exactly what its name implies—it autonomously scans and digitizes manuscripts. But whereas it might take a single librarian days or weeks to scan a single book, the ScanRobot 2.0 can handle up to 2,500 per hour. It’s not sacrificing safety for speed, however. The setup relies on a unique toolkit to ensure it digitizes a book quickly, but with the least amount of direct contact possible.
First, a camera housed in a wedge-shaped case descends down into a book’s center margin, also known as the gutter. Small holes in the triangular plate then generate a vacuum to softly pull pages to either side of the camera’s prism. The imaging unit next ascends up again while scanning both pages simultaneously. Once completed, the vacuum switches off and air nozzles emit a small puff of air to turn the pages. The whole process then repeats again and again, until a book is finished.
But purchasing a ScanRobot 2.0 doesn’t mean the librarians can simply flip it on and leave the room. The library’s department director and rare books cataloger both trained for a week to become certified book robot operators. One of them is always at the control panel whenever the robot is  in use to monitor its progress, adjust settings in real-time, or pause its work altogether.
“Our assessments show that around 64,000 of our books are out of copyright and could be scanned and uploaded, and more books join the public domain every year,” Kunz explained in a
university profile
earlier this year. “There will always be books to make available for our students and scholars.”

data.title: Vintage Macintosh Programming Book Library (2017)
data.author: todsacerdoti
data.article_summary: 本文介绍了Vintage Apple网站上的古董级Macintosh编程书籍库，该库包含超过150本与 vintage Mac编程相关的书籍。这些书籍由Nick R.提供，并经过扫描后分享给社区。库中包括多种编程语言的指南，如Apple Basic、Macintosh Pascal、C语言和汇编语言，以及关于Macintosh工具箱、图形、声音编程和游戏动画的资料。时间跨度主要集中在1983年至1988年，涵盖Macintosh早期开发的各种技术细节和编程方法。感谢Nick的贡献，让这些历史资源得以保存和共享。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于Apple旧文档的回顾与讨论，特别是《Inside Macintosh》以及对现有文档和编程资源的看法。

不同观点：
• whartung认为《Inside Macintosh》在当时并非免费提供，而是需要购买，并回忆了当年以较高价格购买此书的经历，表达了对这些历史文档的喜爱。他还提到希望看到MacTech档案和《Macintosh Revealed》系列书籍。
• pjmlp对比了过去Apple优质的文档与现在的WWDC视频和代码注释生成的文档，暗示过去的方式更有利于开发者学习与参考。
• eschneider提到自己仍保留着大量纸质文档，虽然这些文档已经过时，但在修复某些问题时仍然很难找到替代品，暗示旧文档在特定情况下仍有实用价值。
• burnt-resistor对收藏Apple文化相关的非编程类书籍表示兴趣，例如《Tog on Interface》，强调了这些书籍的文化和历史价值。
• jwrallie提出是否有人将针对旧硬件编程作为爱好，并表示自己正在考虑涉足这一领域，显示出对旧硬件编程的潜在兴趣。
• lachlanj赞赏将这些文档汇集在一起的努力，并表达了对拥有这些文档硬拷贝的向往。
• bradly回忆了自己通过ResEdit入门编程的经历，并对文档中提到的"Jack in the Mac"形象表示怀念。
• snvzz对文档保存工作表示赞赏，并建议考虑通过IPFS镜像站点来保存这些资料，显示出对长期保存和去中心化分发的关注。
• musicale批评Apple当前的文档质量下降，并指出Apple对兼容性的忽视导致应用程序每年都会出现问题，反映出对Apple技术支持的不满。

补充讨论：
• 评论中既有对过去高质量Apple文档的怀念，也有对现有资源的不满和批评。
• 有人关注旧文档的实用性和历史价值，还有人提出对旧硬件编程的兴趣和文档保存的技术建议。
• 争议的焦点主要在于Apple过去与现在的文档质量和开发者支持的对比。

data.title: The Big OOPs: Anatomy of a Thirty-Five Year Mistake
data.author: SerCe
data.article_summary: 《The Big OOPs: Anatomy of a Thirty-Five Year Mistake》是Casey Muratori在Better Software Conference上的演讲总结。演讲探讨了过去三十五年中面向对象编程（OOP）的一些历史失误，重点分析了C++和Smalltalk的发展，以及它们如何影响OOP的普及。由于时间限制，Muratori不得不省略一些细节，如Smalltalk的开发历程。他为希望深入了解的观众提供了四篇历史文章，包括《The Early History of Smalltalk》、《A History of C++》、《The Development of the Simula Languages》和《Origins of the APT Language for Automatically Programmed Tools》。Muratori还表示可能会进行直播，分享更多未包含在演讲中的资料。他对编程历史中的某些早期实例特别感兴趣，并邀请观众提供更多相关信息。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：面向对象编程（OOP）的优缺点及其适用场景

不同观点：
• DavidPiper：认为代码编写应以动词为导向，而不是以对象为导向。他指出，系统的设计取决于人们是更频繁地添加类型还是动作，并认为动作通常更常见。这种观点支持了在某些情况下，非OOP的方式可能更合适。
• chrisg23：赞赏了关于OOP历史的深入讨论，特别是实体组件系统（ECS）在1963年就存在但被遗忘的事实。他强调了ECS未被引入软件设计概念的历史原因。
• lisbbb：作为一名有25年经验的开发者，抱怨OOP的许多问题，特别是在C++和Java中看到的误用。他认为OOP的教条导致了不良实践，并表示现在更喜欢使用非OO的Python和其它语言。
• xg15：承认OOP有缺陷，并不适用于所有环境，特别是在现代计算环境中，数据持久性和函数式编程可能更合适。但同时也指出OOP在某些上下文中仍然有意义，如高层次脚本或游戏编程。
• Rochus：质疑OOP必须将类层次结构对应到领域模型的观点，认为这是对OOP的误解。他引用IEEE等权威组织的定义，强调不应将OOP的实际使用问题与其理论混为一谈。
• MantisShrimp90：支持Casey的观点，认为OOP在行业中被过度使用，并批评那些不愿意承认OOP存在问题的人。
• lproven：请求提供演讲的文字稿，以便更快地阅读和理解内容。
• tw061023：认为社区对OOP的讨论过于偏重于其不良实践，忽略了成功的案例。指出任何语言和方法都可能被滥用，应该探索更好的编程方式。
• rr808：对Casey的OOP定义提出质疑，认为其与传统理解不同，可能需要一个不同的名称。
• nottorp：希望知道所谓的“35年错误”是什么，但不愿意花时间观看长视频。
• cloogshicer：请求关于ECS架构的实际例子或教程，以便学习如何实现。
• voidhorse：认为OOP在许多情况下不合适，编程应更接近数学，而不是语言学，支持函数式编程。批评那些将挑战OOP视为异端的人。

补充讨论：
• OOP的历史和其被遗忘的部分，如ECS架构。
• 不同编程范式（如函数式编程）与OOP的对比。
• OOP在现代计算环境中的适用性及其局限性。
• 社区对OOP的教条态度和对其它编程方式的排斥。
• 对具体技术（如ECS）的实现和学习的兴趣。

争议焦点：
• OOP的定义及其正确应用：是否必须将类层次结构对应到领域模型。
• OOP在现代编程中的适用性和价值：是否应被其它编程范式取代。
• Casey对OOP的批评是否合理及其对行业的意义。

The video from my
Better Software Conference
presentation is now available! You can watch it in its entirety here:
I tried to keep the runtime under two hours while still painting as accurate a historical picture as I could
1
. As a result, I had to leave out many fascinating stories because they weren’t essential to the topic. Entire plotlines - like the development of Smalltalk and the inspirations specific to it, etc. - were not included.
To prepare the talk, I went through many hundreds (perhaps over a thousand?) pages of source material. I really enjoyed piecing together the bigger picture from all the pieces as I found them. Beyond what’s in the talk, there’s a lot of other things I’d love to share with everyone, but I’m not sure how to best do that. Perhaps I’ll do a live stream next week where we can go through some of the documents I didn’t feature in the talk? Is there any interest in that? Let me know in the comments!
For now, if the talk leaves you wanting to explore further, there are four collected “histories” that can get you started. I have linked to them below, with an explanation of what each contains.
The Early History of Smalltalk
. This is Alan Kay’s retrospective on how Smalltalk was developed. Because C++ was the language that pushed the “class hierarchy” methodology into widespread industry use, I left out most of the interesting twists and turns on the Smalltalk side. If you’d like to read more about those, this paper is the place to start.
Please note that I have linked to a
very specific version
. One of the things you will find out if you do research like this is that historical papers are often scanned multiple times, leading to different versions floating around the internet. Many scans of this paper do not include the appendices, which have valuable information for the historical spelunker! The PDF I linked to has the appendices.
A History of C++
. Like its Smalltalk counterpart, this is Bjarne Stroustrup’s retrospective on C++. Stroustrup published a book collecting this and other papers on C++’s development into a single, larger history called
The Design and Evolution of C++
. This paper is essentially the first chapter of the book.
When I quoted from this paper in the talk, I quoted from the book version since it is more recent and more comprehensive. But the two versions are largely the same. That said, if you’re really interested in C++ history, you will want to purchase a copy of the book and read it, since this paper is a small fraction of the total material contained in the book.
The Development of the Simula Languages
. Thankfully, even though Simula was a very early language, Ole-Johan Dahl and Kristen Nygaard did write a history of its development while the memory was still fresh. This paper covers both the creation of Simula I and its second incarnation, Simula 67, where classes and virtual functions first appear.
Origins of the APT Language for Automatically Programmed Tools
. At the same
History of Programming Languages
conference where Dahl and Nygaard published their Simula history, Douglass T. Ross published his history of APT. In this retrospective, Ross places the development of the “plex” around the fall of 1956, making it the earliest instance I could find of the (for lack of a better term) “programming with highly structured data” paradigm that is now literally ubiquitous in both OOP and non-OOP programming today.
Since the talk wasn’t about “finding the earliest true struct”, I only spent a small amount of time trying to find earlier cases than the plex. As I said in the talk, the concept that data could be stored as “records” certainly predated the plex. But the idea that you would create “data structures” in memory that were used to facilitate how the program worked, as opposed to just warehousing data, is much harder to find.
If anyone out there reads this and knows of an earlier example than the plex, please let me know! Although it wasn’t the focus of this talk, unearthing it during this research made me curious to know if it truly was the first, or if there is some other equally-hard-to-find case in the history somewhere.
1
The organizers gave me as much time as I wanted, but I personally felt like anything over two hours would be a bit much for a single presentation!

data.title: Jitsi privacy flaw enables one-click stealth audio and video capture
data.author: zielmicha
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Jitsi Meet中的预加入页面和自动启用音视频功能引发的安全性和隐私问题

不同观点：
• **开发者立场（saghul）**：
  - 解释该功能的存在原因，主要是为了在Jitsi Meet被嵌入时，由“主机”网站提供预加入页面。
  - 提到将限制该功能的使用。

• **漏洞观点（cornholio）**：
  - 认为这是一个重大漏洞，而非功能。
  - 指出用户曾在之前会议中授予Jitsi域名音视频权限，而该域名可能利用这些权限发起由第三方发起的未经请求的会议，第三方可获取受害者的音视频。

• **技术细节与比较（dathinab）**：
  - 指出该问题依赖于`config.prejoinConfig.enabled=false`配置。
  - 质疑为何该配置可通过URL设置，并提到其他视频会议系统也可能存在类似攻击面。
  - 认为如果攻击者控制JS，所有其他视频会议系统都可能面临类似问题。

• **复现尝试（zaggynl）**：
  - 无法复现相机问题，但麦克风确实被自动取消静音。

• **漏洞普遍性（markasoftware）**：
  - 提到此类漏洞（秘密音视频捕捉）很常见，并提供相关链接。

• **功能用途疑问（unsnap_biceps）**：
  - 质疑该功能是否有任何有效的应用场景，难以想象自动加入并启用音视频的合理性。

• **个人反思（3eb7988a1663）**：
  - 反思自己打开多个标签页的习惯，担心其他潜在漏洞。

• **用户体验（Telemakhos）**：
  - 质疑是否可以在不请求麦克风和相机权限的情况下分享视频。
  - 提到自己每次使用Jitsi都需要重新授权。

• **时间点疑问（firefax）**：
  - 怀疑该问题是否新发现，提到自己在疫情期间可能已经遇到过。

• **幽默评论（spaceport, abdellah123）**：
  - 以幽默方式评论该漏洞，表达对隐私的担忧。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点在于该功能是否为设计特性或安全漏洞。
• 对该功能的技术细节、应用场景及普遍性进行了深入探讨。
• 对如何限制该功能的使用，以及其他视频会议系统是否存在类似问题表示关注。
• 有人提到需要进一步研究和公开讨论该问题。

data.title: How YouTube won the battle for TV viewers
data.author: JumpCrisscross
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：YouTube与其他流媒体平台的对比，内容创作和观看体验的优劣，广告与盈利模式的影响

不同观点：
• **YouTube的长视频创作与盈利难度**：
  - [toisanji] 提到在YouTube上创作长视频内容很有趣，但缺乏更好的盈利方式。
  
• **YouTube长视频内容的质量与观看体验优于传统电视**：
  - [legitster] 认为YouTube的长视频内容比电视节目更专注和深入，且没有为了迎合广泛观众而频繁切换主题，观看体验更好。
  - 例子：Animagraffs关于胡佛大坝的视频比电视纪录片更详细。

• **流媒体服务减少原创内容导致YouTube优势**：
  - [radley] 指出由于流媒体服务减少原创内容以及2023年的制作成本和罢工问题，YouTube填补了这一空白，并通过幕后花絮等形式提供了更多内容。

• **YouTube的电视观看体验不佳**：
  - [linsomniac] 认为YouTube在观看电视节目方面的用户体验很差，无法方便地连续观看下一集，且推荐算法容易陷入重复推荐。

• **YouTube的垄断地位与其他平台的竞争**：
  - [JKCalhoun] 认为YouTube已经成为事实上的垄断者，因为创作者和观众都在此聚集，其他平台难以打破这一局面。
  - [ksec] 补充，Google和Apple未能提供一个整合所有广播电视内容的平台，导致目前的状态。

• **YouTube的多样性与创新**：
  - [apricot13] 强调YouTube让创作者和观众自由选择和创作内容，使得各方受益，且涵盖音乐、小众艺术家等多种内容。

• **传统电视与流媒体内容质量下降**：
  - [unixhero] 认为现在的电视节目质量不如90年代的经典节目。

• **YouTube在音乐流媒体中的地位**：
  - [consumer451] 提到YouTube在音乐流媒体中也占据重要地位，这令人惊讶。

• **YouTube推荐算法的局限性**：
  - [wanderingmind] 希望YouTube像Twitter一样可以查看喜欢的频道订阅的其他频道，以避免被推荐算法局限。

• **广告对观看体验的影响**：
  - [heavensteeth] 表示由于广告过多，自己已经多年不看电视或听广播，而YouTube的广告相对较少。

• **YouTube在不同设备上的使用体验**：
  - [al_borland] 提到自己98%的YouTube观看是在AppleTV上进行的。

• **YouTube Premium的价值**：
  - [h4kunamata] 认为YouTube Premium值得订阅，因为YouTube Music比Spotify好，且YouTube内容丰富，尽管存在垄断问题。

补充讨论：
• **家庭媒体管理平台的流行**：
  - [ddtaylor] 提到Jellyfin在他们家中很受欢迎，并指出YouTube常被视为快速消费内容的平台，而家庭更倾向于观看有深度和较长时间的内容。

争议焦点：
• **YouTube的推荐算法和内容组织方式**受到一些用户的批评，认为其不够灵活和智能，而另一些用户则欣赏YouTube内容的自由度和多样性。

主要讨论点：NativeSwap的工作原理及其与Thorchain和Mayachain的关系

不同观点：
• [dnpp123的观点] NativeSwap似乎是基于Thorchain和Mayachain协议实现跨链功能的应用。dnpp123质疑NativeSwap是否仅仅是一个围绕Thorchain和Mayachain的包装，并提出如果用户想直接使用Thorchain，为什么不直接使用而要通过NativeSwap。该评论者对NativeSwap的独特价值表示怀疑。

• [adi_hn07的观点] adi_hn07对NativeSwap表示赞赏，并表达了希望在Superlaunch平台上使用该应用的兴趣。该评论没有对技术细节或工作原理提出质疑，而是表达了对应用的正面兴趣和潜在使用场景。

补充讨论：
• dnpp123的评论中提到了跨链交易中的安全性与去中心化问题，指出NativeSwap利用Thorchain和Mayachain的协议来确保用户对资产的完全控制，并且不需要使用包装代币或中心化桥接器。
• dnpp123进一步对应用的必要性提出质疑，认为如果用户可以直连Thorchain，那么NativeSwap的独特卖点或附加价值可能不明显。

• NativeSwap是否仅仅是Thorchain和Mayachain的简单包装，以及其相对于直接使用Thorchain的独特价值是什么。

data.title: AMD CEO sees chips from TSMC's US plant costing 5%-20% more
data.author: mfiguiere
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：AMD CEO关于美国芯片制造的言论及其影响

不同观点：
• **Intel的未来竞争力**：
  - **timmg**：Intel曾经是美国科技的佼佼者，但近年来多次宣布延迟或关闭某些产品，质疑其是否能与台积电（TSMC）竞争。
  - **dathinab**：认为即便成本增加5%-20%，某些客户（如政府、CIA、NSA等）仍会接受，因为他们更关注美国制造。

• **芯片成本与供应链**：
  - **mmmBacon**：文章未说明成本差异的原因，推测可能是由于新工厂的成熟度不同导致良率差异，从而影响成本。
  - **proee**：指出半导体工厂的主要成本是资本支出，而非劳动力成本，测试设备等昂贵设备占大头。
  - **viktorcode**：认为最终美国制造的CPU售价增幅将远超20%。

• **地缘政治与市场竞争**：
  - **octopoc**：讨论美国试图通过控制AI芯片供应来制约中国芯片制造业的发展，同时提到中美之间的芯片贸易限制。
  - **aylmao**：指出如果中国赶上，5%-20%的成本增加可能会使美国芯片失去价格优势，建议将制造转移到墨西哥等国家。

• **其他考量**：
  - **seangrogg**：提到不仅需要考虑CPU的成本，还需关注主板等其他电子元件的供应问题。
  - **nottorp**：不愿意接受芯片在美国制造，认为台湾制造即可。
  - **gtirloni**：指出即便芯片在美国制造，可能仍需运回台湾进行封装。

补充讨论：
• **长期经济效益**：
  - **reliabilityguy**：认为从长期看，在美国拥有芯片工厂对经济有积极影响，包括增加就业、本地供应链和本地专业知识等。

• **对媒体报道的质疑**：
  - **alexnewman**：批评Bloomberg文章标题误导，认为内容不严谨。

争议焦点：美国芯片制造的成本增加是否值得，以及是否能长期保持竞争优势。

data.title: BYD Bets on Budget EV Boom with Atto 1 Debut in Indonesia
data.author: breve
data.article_summary: 中国电动车巨头比亚迪（BYD）在印度尼西亚推出了其最便宜的电动车车型Atto 1，售价低于2亿印尼盾（约12,270美元）。该车型在唐格朗举行的Gaikindo印尼国际车展（GIIAS）上亮相，标志着其在东南亚市场的首次发布。Atto 1分为两个版本：Dynamic版售价195百万印尼盾（12,000美元），续航里程达300公里；Premium版售价235百万印尼盾（14,800美元），续航里程达380公里。此举旨在开拓入门级电动车市场，特别是在印尼这个东南亚最大汽车市场，该市场电动车渗透率在2025年上半年已升至10%。

BYD Bets on Budget EV Boom With Atto 1 Debut in Indonesia
Wahyu Sahala Tua
July 23, 2025 | 3:25 pm
SHARE
URL berhasil di salin.
Chinese EV giant BYD launches its entry-level model, Atto 1, at the Gaikindo Indonesia International Auto Show (GIIAS) in Tangerang, Banten, Wednesday, July 23, 2025. (Beritasatu Photo/Wahyu Sahala Tua)
Tangerang.
Chinese electric vehicle giant BYD has officially launched its most affordable EV model to date, the Atto 1, in Indonesia -- priced at under Rp 200 million (approximately $12,270). The launch took place at the Gaikindo Indonesia International Auto Show (GIIAS) on Wednesday in Tangerang, Banten.
Known globally as the BYD Seagull, the Atto 1 will make its Southeast Asian debut in Indonesia, which will serve as the entry point for the model’s regional rollout. The launch is part of BYD’s broader strategy to tap into the underserved entry-level EV segment in the region.

data.title: BGP.Tools: Browse the Internet Ecosystem
data.author: RGBCube
data.article_summary: BGP.Tools 提供免费和付费的BGP（边界网关协议）数据服务。免费服务包括近实时的BGP数据、用户友好的界面以及频繁更新的外部数据。付费服务则包括BGP网络监控和IRR数据库监控。网站还列出了不同日期的更新日志，并提供示例页面和连接信息，如用户的IPv4地址、连接延迟等。该工具适合网络工程师和需要监控互联网路由情况的专业人士使用。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：BGP（边界网关协议）相关的工具、资源及其应用

不同观点：
• rumblefrog对地图（https://map.bgp.tools/）表示了浓厚的兴趣，特别提到奔驰公司拥有一个大块IP地址段（53.0.0.0/8），且大部分未使用。
• thisisgvrt分享了一个视频链接（https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=83NJllv0q9U），该视频提供了有关数据收集和解析的幕后花絮。
• tomhow提到了之前关于BGP.Tools的讨论，并附上了一个链接（https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=36531988），该讨论发生在2023年6月，共有17条评论。
• ddtaylor提到了过去的一次数据中心中断事件，并表示当时试图快速学习BGP以判断是否是BGP导致的中断，但未成功。他询问了在专家报告之前判断BGP是否导致大规模中断的方法或工具。
• dapperdrake对BGP工具表示赞赏，并预测在ASN（自治系统号）层面阻止机器人活动将变得普遍。
• j4nek表示BGP.Tools是他最常用的网站之一，并对网站的创建者表示感谢。
• TheBoozyGenius仅简单评论“Pretty zany”，没有具体展开。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点：目前没有明显争议，但ddtaylor提出了一个实际操作中的技术问题，即如何在专家报告之前判断BGP是否导致大规模中断，这可能引发对BGP监控工具和方法的进一步讨论。
• 工具和资源推荐：thisisgvrt分享的视频提供了一个学习BGP数据处理的视角，而dapperdrake和j4nek都对BGP.Tools表示了积极的评价，说明该工具在社区中具有一定的影响力和实用性。
• 实际应用问题：ddtaylor的问题揭示了在实际网络运维中快速判断BGP问题的需求，这可能是一个值得深入探讨的技术挑战。

总结：评论主要围绕BGP相关的工具、资源及其在实际应用中的问题展开，涉及具体工具的推荐与使用体验分享，以及技术问题的探讨。
